articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Automated Testing Framework for Linux Software GUI Testing
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: It is complicated but important for the Linux software GUI testing. However, the industry is still lack of the useful testing tools for the Linux software GUI testing. This paper designed and implemented a testing tool based on OSGI. The automated testing framework supports the keyword-driven test script management and implementation, and also supports the distributed testing management. It had been proved that the testing tool is quite suitable for the Linux software GUI testing.

articleTitle: Pilot Design for MIMO OFDM Channel Estimation Regard to Guard Band
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In this paper, the problem of placing training sequence for multiple-input multiple-output/orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (MIMO/OFDM) systems in the presence of the guard band is considered and a least square (LS) channel estimation is discussed. First, the minimum mean square error (MSE) of the LS channel estimation is computed and then optimal pilot placement which can achieve the minimum MSE with guard band is derived. We propose pilot placements which are not placed in the guard band and minimize the MSE. We compare our scheme with comb pilots. In contrast with equal-power and equal-distance pilots, this design has better performance and satisfies the minimum MSE. Simulation results demonstrate effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: A Multiple Access Scheme for the Uplink of MIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In order to efficiently use the common channel resources in multi-user multiple-input and multiple-output (MIMO) systems, an independent component based multiple access (ICMA) scheme is introduced. In ICMA, the signals generated by different users are distinguished only from their independence, where neither non-interfering subchannels nor orthogonality constraints are needed. The scheme is based on independent component analysis (ICA) algorithm, which is a fundamental technique for blind source separation. The performance of the proposed receiver is compared with zero forcing (ZF) receiver and minimum mean-square error (MMSE) receiver. Simulation results show that ICMA receiver performs better than ZF receiver, and worse than MMSE receiver. However, in ICMA, there is no need of synchronization and channal estimation, which is required in ZF and MMSE. The efficiencies of the scheme are observed.

articleTitle: A New Circuit Modeling Methodology for RFID Antennas with Vector Fitting Technique
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In this paper, we describe a new method of SPICE-compatible circuit modeling for RFID antennas. It is derived from the input impedance or admittance of the antenna and the Vector Fitting method. The antenna input impedance can be easily simulated by an EM simulator or measured using a vector network analyzer. And the method of Vector Fitting is employed to convert its input impedance to a SPICE equivalent circuit. The most important contribution of this study is to show that RF components such as antennas can be integrated into the simulation of communication systems and helps system designers to predict and consider the effect of the RF components in the design process.

articleTitle: Study and Simulation of GTS Allocation in Beacon Enabled IEEE 802.15.4
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In order to become truly ubiquitous, the Internet of Things (IoT) has to evolve to provide connectivity anytime, any place, for any thing. IEEE 802.15.4-based wireless personal area networks (WPANs) is a preferable communication method for IoT. Wireless personal area networks (WPANs) are used to convey information over relatively short distances. Connections effected via WPANs involve little or no infrastructure. And the IEEE 802.15.4 protocol proposes a flexible communication solution for time-sensitive Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) applications due to the Guaranteed Time Slot (GTS) medium access control mechanism. Several OPNET simulations were done to evaluate the performance of GTS allocation mechanism, which providing a basis direction for further analysis.

articleTitle: An Ultrasonic Detecting Method Testing for Defects in Profiled Component
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Profiled component has some structural features, such as thin wall, small diameter and corner angle on inner wall. These features make it very difficult to detect the profiled component with ultrasound method, and the waves reflected from the inside arris have badly interfered the identification of echo signal. The ultrasonic creeping wave is used to detect the profiled component. In order to eliminate impact of inner edge wave, echo signals are divided into two parts to assure the fatal defect in the top of inner arc is not undetected. Time and amplitude characteristic value of flaw signals are extracted to distinguish between flaw signal and inner edge wave effectively. The testing results indicate that the detection with above feature extraction method can meet the application requirements of real-time, accuracy and reliability, and it would have good application foreground for on-line detection.

articleTitle: LPM-Turbo Decoding Structure Based on Simulink
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Turbo decoding model with the linear prediction model is developed in Simulink based on the turbo decoding theory to replace one of iterations and reduce the decoding delay time. The factors are presented in the results of simulation, which are the linear prediction model, the length of interleave and the different decoding arithmetics that influence on the error-correcting performance of the modified structure of turbo decoder. The error-rate performance of turbo decoding structure based on the linear prediction model is only lower by 0.0~0.2dB than the traditional one, and the modified model can reduce the decoding delay time. As the length of interleave increases, the performance of the modified decoding structure also increases, but the length of interleave should be chosen properly because the decoding delay time is proportional to the length of interleave. Log-MAP algorithm has the best performance, the performance of which is 0.5dB higher than MAX-Log-MAP algorithm when BER is 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>.

articleTitle: Performance of Code-Orthogonalized Transmitted-Reference Ultra-Wideband System in Presence of Interference
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: This paper studies the performance of Code-Orthogonalized Transmitted-Reference Ultra-Wideband (COTR-UWB) system in presence of interference. The output component expression of COTR-UWB receivers in presence of single frequency interference is deduced in detail. In addition, in presence of narrowband jamming signal, the performances of three kinds of UWB systems(COTR-UWB, time-domain reference UWB and frequency-domain reference UWB)are simulated and compared. The theoretical analysis and simulation show that the performance of COTR-UWB system is the same as frequency-domain reference UWB system, and superior to time-domain reference UWB.

articleTitle: The Geographic Structure Query Language Based on the Peer to Peer and Cooperating Computing Hybrid Discovering Model
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: The management of the magnanimous spatial data needs the distributed cooperative GIS platform. This paper proposed the Peer To Peer and Cooperating Computing Hybrid Discovering Model of Distributed Geospatial Information. Based on the (Spatial Resource Discovery Agent (SRDA) and ordinary neighbor node, Combined with Spatial data model of MAPGIS7.0, this article brings up the geographic structure query language in P2P network (P2PGSQL), and has designed the interpreter of P2PGSQL. In the Peer To Peer and Cooperating Computing Hybrid Discovering Model, this paper has designed the algorithms that construct the distributed hash table and decrease the delay. By discovering and performing the potential swaps that are beneficial to the match between overlay and physical network, it can reduce the average latency and improve the performance of the system. Based on the P2P Cooperating Computing Hybrid Discovering Model, this article has given the method of the P2PGSQL in grid environment and built the mapping model of the global spatial query sentence to the local query sentence. With constituting a global spatial data resource catalog to record the distributing information of all spatial database on each node, P2PGSQL has backed up effective expression of spatial database management mission in grid environment. Hence, P2PGSQL can sustain the query of distribute spatial data in grid environment. This article has extended the grid spatial relation operation (Intersection, Union, Difference) and synthesized operation (Length, Buffer, intersecting region) and so on. The P2PGSQL can reduce the quantity of spatial data transmitting among nodes and enhance the capacity of parallel operation. At the same time, P2PGSQL can also sustain multi-spatial data model by the extension of structure data on the data type. At the end, an experimental instance of P2PGSQL has been carried out based on mapgis7.0 platform.

articleTitle: Random Network Coding for Unicast in Wireless Cellular Network
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: With Network Coding, a source can multicast information at a rate approaching the smallest minimum cut between the source and any terminal through encoding the incoming packets at intermediate node. On the other hand, in current wireless systems, terminals could receive multiple cells signal, but only registered cell's packets could be used, and others are dropped as useless or noise. This traditional way didn't make full use of information received by terminals. In this paper, a new transmission scheme using random network coding (RNCT) is introduced, in which all signals received by terminal are useful. Simulations show that this new scheme can improve spectral efficiency and wireless system throughput significantly than current transmission scheme (CTS).

articleTitle: A Compact LTCC Balun for Bluetooth/WLAN Application
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In this paper, a 2.4-2.5 GHz Marchand balun,which uses semi-lumped concept and LTCC technology, has been newly designed,simulated, and fabricated. The measured results and the results of computer simulation show a good match. The balun is implemented with a ten-layer commercial low temperature co-fired ceramic (LTCC) process. Between 2.4 GHz and 2.5 GHz ,the measured insertion loss is small than 1.3 dB and return loss is better than 20 dB. The amplitude imbalance is less than 0.25 dB and the phase balance is within 180° ±4.5°. The overall dimension is as small as 2 mm × 1.25 mm × 0.96 mm.

articleTitle: A New Region of Interest Based Image Quality Assessment Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In recent years, great progress has been achieved in algorithms about image quality assessment (IQA). Several IQA algorithms have been put forward with high correlation with human perception. However, these algorithms can perform even better. In this paper, one strategy is proposed based on region of interest (ROI) in which some alternation on structure similarity (SSIM) are made to enhance the correlation with human perception. In addition, experimental results are demonstrated to highlight the improvement.

articleTitle: Network Coded Multicast Retransmission Scheme Based on Opportunistic Relaying
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: It is well known that opportunistic relaying combats wireless fading and network coding in multicast reduces retransmission times. In this article, a network coded multicast retransmission scheme based on opportunistic relaying (NCMR-OR) is proposed, which combines the two above techniques to further improve the efficiency of wireless multi-hop multicast. The outage probability and transmission bandwidth are deduced when two destinations are involved. The numerical results show that NCMR-OR is more efficient than the schemes that employs either opportunistic relaying or network coding in multicast.

articleTitle: Analysis of Intrusion Management System Technology
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: With the increase of network intrusion and hacking, the network security has become a main problem in computer science and attracts much attention from people.To solve these problems, this paper first analysis the advantages and disadvantages of the traditional security technologies in solve these security problem.Next, introduces an intrusion management system, which can make up for these deficiencies. Then it has a further study of the basic principle of the intrusion prevention system.

articleTitle: Frequency Synchronization in MIMO OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: MIMO OFDM is a promising technique for the future wireless communications. However, the performance of MIMO OFDM systems is very sensitive to carrier frequency offset (CFO) which introduces inter-carrier-interference (ICI). Therefore, frequency synchronization is a critical problem in MIMO OFDM systems. In this paper, we study the problem of frequency synchronization in MIMO OFDM systems and propose a novel frequency synchronization scheme which uses training sequences composed of repeated pseudo-noise (PN) sequences for CFO estimation. Simulation results demonstrate that our scheme has very good performance, and is more robust and accurate than Schenk's scheme both in the AWGN channel and in the multipath channel.

articleTitle: Design on Parallel Structure of DSSS Receiver Using FPGA
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In this paper, a novel high-speed parallel structure of low-pass filter for filtering and matched algorithm for searching synchronization in DSSS receiver is studied. We extend previous implements for introducing parallelism into the design of Direct Sequence Spread Spectrum (DSSS) receiver. Design techniques, such as parallel structure, optimized compressor cells and pipeline architecture for reducing the hardware resource consumption of multiplier , adder and look-up tables (LUT), use to realize a high-speed processing, precise synchronized and reconfigurable DSSS receiver. The design trade-offs analyzed with ISE 10.1 in detail, including the maximum frequency and number of resources of slices, bonded IOs and GCLKs, and implemented with a XC4VLX160 FPGA device.

articleTitle: Research of Modern Drilling Instrument System Based on the Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: The drilling engineering is a high-cost and high-risk project. So the drilling projects have introduced a series of equipments and devices as drilling supplement, whose parameter showing provide some dynamic information, and provide scientific evidence for technical staffs such as the drillers. The wireless communications technology makes the communication between drilling sites and oil bases be more smooth along with increasing the bandwidth of wireless network. The technology provides new possibilities for improvement of drilling equipment system. At present, the oil industry internationalization and many oil fields locating in the turbulent areas request the site and the base to be connected as a whole, so, the demand for the staff in base controlling the on-site equipment grows. This article presents an architecture for the drilling instrument systems connecting the drilling field and the base of oil field. It establishes the two-way data transmission channel, through which the real-time acquisition data, system configuration data and operating commands can communicate with each other. It collects the signals from sensors in drilling equipments, and transmits these signals to the on-site application and monitoring systems, then stores them in the on-site local databases, and finally the data will be calculated professionally in the base and be stored in the global database. Personnel at the base can monitor and control the well fields, and they can also complete the on-site equipment operation, system software settings, sensor calibration and so on. This system discussed in this article reduces the number of on-site personal, improves the utilization rate of expert in base and reduce the risk of personnel in risk areas and the cost of drilling.

articleTitle: Wireless Data Collection System Design Based on AT86RF212
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Abstract-Basing on the radio-frequency chip AT86RF212, the paper designed a wireless Data collection system. According to the performances and characters of chip AT86RF212,It adopted the company ATMEL's ZigBee protocol stack Bitcloud to carry through software development. Meanwhile, using the serial interface communication technologies,it realized data processing and displaying by Labview technologies. With the help of the experiment results, it could conclude that the designed system would have a good practical prospect.

articleTitle: The Opportunistic Scheduling Model of Multiple Users Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In the paper the opportunistic scheduling approaches to further enhance the throughput of next generation wireless networks of multiple users. Our framework enables us to investigate various categories of scheduling problems, use optimal solutions for these scheduling problems. An attractive feature of these optimal solutions is that they are given in a simple parametric form. We provide algorithms to estimate the parameters in these optimal solutions and describe implementation procedures for the solution. An advantage of opportunistic scheduling is that it can be coupled with other resource management mechanisms to further increase network performance. We summarize various opportunistic scheduling schemes also discuss the advantages and costs associated with opportunistic scheduling, and identify possible future research directions.

articleTitle: Image Cheat Encryption Algorithm Based on Hyperchaotic System
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In this paper, a novel image cheat-encryption algori-thm based on hyper-chaotic Chen-system is proposed. The hyper-chaos is employed to encrypt plain image into cheat-like image. The cheat-image is transferred in network and easily neglected by attackers. If cheat succeeds, it is impossible to decrypt. When the cheat-image fails to cheat the attackers, security and performance analysis shows the cheat-encryption method still has the same confidentiality as the cover-encryption.

articleTitle: A Hierarchical Backbone Network Based on VLB Architecture
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: The increasing growth of the global Internet making the shortcomings of its unstructured topology and distributed routing algorithm are exposed more rapidly. To design a controllable, scalable and manageable backbone network with a simple, efficient architecture is very imperative. Among many topologies, Tree topology which has a natural hierarchical structure and explicit end-to-end transmission path provides a promising solution for the future Internet architecture. To overcome the defects of tree topology in reliability and scalability, we propose a hierarchical network based on Viliant load-balancing (VLB) architecture which takes advantage of the both. The analysis of its fault-tolerance property and the corresponding flow-level load-balancing scheme are also presented in the paper.

articleTitle: Low Complexity Mode Depended Local Adaptive Interpolation Filter for Next Generation Video Coding
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: H.264/AVC utilizes the motion prediction with motion vectors at fractional (1/4-pixel). Interpolation filter is utilized to generate the information in the positions between integer positions. Adaptive interpolation filters that adaptively calculate the coefficients by frame have been adopted in KTA tools which were set up as software platform of new proposals for the next video standard. Among several AIFs, EAIF achieved best rate reduction with averagely 7% over all sequences, with complexity doubled. The high complexity restricts its practical applications under current digital computing ability. To reduce the total encoding complexity, mode depended AIF adoption and local macroblock utilization methods are proposed in this paper. It is shown that efficiency of AIF can be related to mode partition distributions which are generated in the first coding pass. By applying different threshold with different QP, the usage of AIF in each frame can be decided. A further complexity reduction is achieved by locally determining the filter usage on each macroblock based on the macroblock characteristics in the second coding pass. Combing two methods, encoding complexity reduction of 40% could be achieved averagely over CIF sequences by means of motion estimation time with negligible penalty to PSNR.

articleTitle: Coseismic Deformation of 2009 L'Aquila, Italy Earthquake Derived from Ascending and Descending ENVISAT/ASAR Images
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: The Mw6.3 L'Aquila earthquake (in central Italy) occurred on 6 April 2009 and caused ground displacements. In order to study this earthquake mechanism, three tracks(track 079, 129, 401) ENVISAT/ASAR images, which include ascending and descending data, were used to derive different line of sight directions coseismic deformation based on the technique of two pass differential interferometric synthetic aperture rada (D-InSAR). The coseismic deformation results are quite consistent with the GPS measurements, and the RMSs (root mean squre) in LOS between GPS and coseismic deformation of three tracks are 15mm, 26mm, 20mm respectively. This demonstrates that the D-InSAR LOS deformation accuracy can reach centimeter's level here. These coseismic deformations show that the earthquake fault is right lateral fault, the strike is NW-ES direction, and the largest LOS deformations of the three tracks are -268mm, -233mm, -255mm respectively.

articleTitle: Channel Estimation and Space-Time Decoding under MIMO System
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Recursive expectation-maximization (EM) algorithm along with stochastic approximation is employed in this paper to estimate unknown time-invariant/variant parameters. In addition, we modify the conventional Viterbi algorithm used in space-time encoder under the MIMO system, and give the recursive metric equation. The modified Viterbi algorithm can be used in the receiver when the MIMO channel information has been estimated. Compared with the conventional decoding algorithm, the improved algorithm can be used in the every receiver respectively. It is shown that the improved algorithm is also an optimal algorithm, however, its metric convergence speed is faster than the standard Viterbi algorithm.

articleTitle: The Meta-Requirements Model Study for Trusted Software
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: The paper puts forward meta-requirement method, a new method of requirement analysis and management, for the features of large trusted software systems. First of all, the paper introduced the definition and constituent elements of meta-requirement basing on other previous studies. Then the paper builds meta-requirement analysis model using tree structure in accordance with its definition and constituent elements, and identify the number of meta-requirements. Finally, the paper carries out correlation analysis between meta-requirements according to the constituent elements of meta-requirement.

articleTitle: Application for Economy PID Arithmetic Based on Wavelet Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: The wavelet neural network has already been widely applied to the fields of signal processing and industrial detection etc. Proportion-integration-differentiation(PID) arithmetic is very common in industrial control. it can greatly improve the efficiency of economy if they are integrated. the PID control arithmetic based on the wavelet neural network is proposed to apply to the economy air condition. the software and hardware of system is implemented by TMS320F2812. Compared with the traditional schemas, it proves to be optimized, high in stability and efficiency.

articleTitle: Modeling of Heterogeneous Multidimensional ADHOC
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: By analyzing architecture of existing Heterogeneous wireless networks, mapping wireless resource management to wireless measurement indexing, proposed an improved model of CAN multidimensional ADHOC. Simulation result showing improvement in connectivity, network maintenance cost etc.

articleTitle: Target Detection Based on Elastic Wave Propagation Equations
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In this paper, a new target detection method is proposed by implying the elastic wave propagation equations. Firstly, the generalization of Hook's law is utilized to establish the elastic wave propagation equations. Then, a fast second-order semi-discrete finite difference scheme is presented to solve the elastic wave propagation equations. The method here can detect different objects from a noisy image, with various shapes and with an interior contour. Detection of different objects from a color image can be derived straightforwardly. By comparing, the fast solver has high efficiency at the same time.

articleTitle: Computationally Efficient QO-STBC OFDM Transmitters
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a computationally efficient MIMO OFDM transmitter using QO-STBC schemes. Straightforward implementation of these systems requires separate inverse fast Fourier transform (IFFT) processing blocks for each of the transmit antennas. In our proposed scheme, we use symmetry properties of Fourier transform, and greatly reduce the computational burden. The proposed scheme uses just a single IFFT block at each OFDM symbol period.

articleTitle: A Method to Improve Performance of Turbo Iterative Decoding in Low SNR Region
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: As far as a Turbo decoder is concerned, the lower Bit Err Rate (BER) at the expense of acceptable and feasible complexity, the better. In this paper, a method is proposed which employs additional redundant sequence added at the end of tail bits of an information sequence to improve performance of a Turbo decoder. Computer simulation results show that, when L=L'=1024, where L is the length of information sequence and L' the length of redundant sequence, the method obtained about 0.45dB at BER=10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> and about 0.35dB at BER=10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup> respectively compared to the case of L=1024 without redundancies, and also about 0.3dB at BER=10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> and about 0.1dB at BER=10-4 compared to the case of L=2048 without redundancies. It is superior to these two cases until Sinal to Noise Ratio (SNR)=0.9dB with moderate extra expenses.

articleTitle: Joint Angle Estimation for Bistatic MIMO Radar
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: A new joint direction of arrivals (DOAs) and direction of departures (DODs) estimation algorithm for bistatic multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) radar is proposed. Instead of two-dimensional nonlinear search or iterative computation, the algorithm uses a one-dimensional search to estimate the DOAs, and then the DODs can be obtained; therefore they can be paired automatically. Furthermore, the algorithm can solve the problem of joint angle estimation when angle ambiguity of DODs occurs. The performance of the proposed algorithm is validated by the simulation results.

articleTitle: The Application of Wireless Communication in Mountain Highway Landslide Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In the remote monitoring system developed by the authors for highway landslide, GPRS net of China Mobile is applied to transfer data in real time, Microsoft Visual C++ network technology and SQL Server 2005 data base are used to realize the target of real-time remote receiving and visual management of monitoring data. With the advantages of economy, high accuracy, high automation and high efficiency, the remote monitoring system has been successfully applied in Changji highway and Louxin highway in Hunan Province, to provide safety security and environment protection.

articleTitle: Research of High-Reliability Transmission Based on Wireless Foundation Fieldbus
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: For the purpose of improving reliability of wireless Foundation Fieldbus (FF), we increased redundancy of the transmission path and compensated for poor communication quality of wireless communication in harsh industrial environments partly. The multi-path transmission mechanism based on wireless FF is proposed. The topology of dual-band and secondary structure based on FF is designed, and it allows use of independent frequency bands to communication on devices and communication controllers. So as to diminish the chance of conflict and the effective use of space capacity to work in parallel. At the same time, we introduce to DS-UWB in wireless FF. The project of wireless FF integrated with UWB are designed on the multi-path transmission mechanism based on topology of dual-band and secondary structure. It provides an effective application way of high-reliability transmission based on wireless FF.

articleTitle: Match Information Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Match information opinions are presented in this paper. It reveals that the information is relevant not only to the thing's occurring probability but also to the degree of matching the external messages with the internal memory models. The statistical information is fit for the channel coding and the match information is fit for the source coding. Based on the idea of match information, a new memory match image and video compression coding algorithm is presented to save a great deal of transmission bandwidth and provide high compression ratio while processing more and more image or video frames. Moreover, a kind of memory-renewed personal communication system is also proposed to satisfy different individual demands. The memory model may be renewed online in this system while it is idle. It also may be applied in secure communication or toll television and so on.

articleTitle: An Inter-Cluster Gateway-Based Energy-Efficient Routing Protocol
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In the existing clustering protocol, cluster heads (CHs) usually transmit data to Sink directly with long-distance transmission and huge energy consumption. To solve this problem, an inter-cluster gateway-based energy-efficient routing protocol (IGER) is proposed in this paper. It makes cluster heads evenly distributed, chooses appropriate nodes to be gateways for inter-cluster communication to share CHs' energy consumption. Simulations show that IGER consumes very little energy, effectively balances energy consumption of all nodes, and prolongs the network lifetime, outperforms LEACH, PEGASIS and iHEED.

articleTitle: Image Restoration and Enhancement Based on Tunable Forward-and-Backward Diffusion
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: This paper introduced a novel tunable forward-and-backward (TFAB) diffusion approach for edge enhancement and image restoration. In this algorithm, an alternative FAB diffusion process is presented where it is possible to better modulate diffusion behavior and it shows better algorithm behavior. In addition, the algorithm can do away with the necessity to laboriously determine the value of the gradient threshold. We believe the TFAB diffusion to be an adaptive mechanism for image restoration and enhancement. Qualitative experiments and quantitative analyses show significant improvements when the TFAB diffusion algorithm is employed compared to the existing anisotropic diffusion and the previous FAB diffusion algorithms for enhancing edge features and improving image contrast.

articleTitle: A New IFFT Method for Mobile-to-Mobile Rice Channels in VANET
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Inter-vehicle communication find increasing application in futuristic intelligent transport systems and ad hoc mobile networks. However, the channel statistical properties for these mobile-to- mobile channel are quite different from traditional cellular wireless networks, and need to modify the simulation method. The paper proposes a method to simulate the Rician-faded mobile-to-mobile local in three-dimensional scattering scenario, based on a model for mobile-to-mobile Rayleigh channel. The method proposed here can simulate any K-factor according to a database, which is convenient compared with other existing method.

articleTitle: Greedy Approximation with Regard to Some Normalized Bases
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Nonlinear approximation plays an important role in machine learning, signal processing and statistical estimating. In this paper we study the efficiency of greedy algorithm for nonlinear approximation. We estimate the error for greedy approximation with regard to some normalized bases with different properties.

articleTitle: Quasi-Linear Programming Model of Stochastic Transportation Problems
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Stochastic transportation problems attract much attention in many fields, such as resource allocation, production management, etc. In this paper, after analyzing how to process random constraints in chance constrained programming, propose a quasi-linear pattern based on expectation and variance, moreover, give the quasi-linear programming model of stochastic transportation problems with good operability, finally, the performance of this model is discussed through an example. All these indicate the quasi-linear programming model can solve the stochastic transportation problems briefly and effectively, so it enriches methods of stochastic transportation problems.

articleTitle: Gaussian Approximation for LDPC Codes under Group Shuffled Belief Propagation Decoding
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Group shuffled belief propagation (GSBP) algorithm is a modified algorithm to decode LDPC codes. Compared with belief propagation decoding, this algorithm converges faster. In this paper, we analyze the performance of GSBP decoding by means of Gaussian approximation. Under the assumption of Gaussian density, the updating message means during GSBP decoding are derived. The results show that the proposed algorithm can verify the fast convergence property of GSBP decoding effectively.

articleTitle: Cobwebb Antennas Applied on HF Communications
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In order to build Timely and effective communication in HF blind-spot (20-100KM), Cobwebb folded dipole antenna was designed as well as matching circuitry. In this paper, antenna structure and antenna electric-height are simulated and amended in the use of electromagnetic simulation software FEKO. Antenna radiation patterns in the different electric-height are given. It is clear that the proper electrical antenna height from the ground is λ/4 in the simulation and actual test results and maximum gain is got in the direction of the vertical incidence (NVIS-Near Vertical Incidence Sky wave). The actual field test, Cobwebb antenna with the FT-450 HF radio work well in blind-spot, in addition to Cobwebb antenna does not require the land to build a complex network system, set up evacuation quickly, very suitable for tactical and strategic HF communications.

articleTitle: Impact of Mobility-Adaptive Mechanisms on Stability-Orient Routing in Mobile Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Although establishing stable routes for routing can improve the performance of mobile an hoc networks (MANETs), the improvement will be weakened to a degree for the stability of route is sensitive to the motion of node. In this paper, based on a basic stability-oriented routing scheme, named FORP, we involved two mobility-adaptive mechanisms in it. One mechanism is the real-time update of stability with the motion of node. The other one is the pre-discovery of the backup route and we gave the rule to regulate this process. The aims of the mechanisms are to make the stability of route be adaptive to the mobility and weaken the bad impact of motion on performance of MANETs further. Then NS-2.29 is used as the simulation tool to study the impact of the mechanisms on FORP. The results show the two mechanisms can further improve the performance of MANET effectively.

articleTitle: The Movement Estimation of Target and Background by Fourier Phase Spectrum Difference
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: An algorithm for estimating displacement of the moving target and background by shift theory of Fourier transform is presented. According to the relation between the change and the Fourier transform of image sequence, the method employs the displacement value of the moving target and background by the difference of Fourier phase spectrum. The algorithm estimates the movements from the whole field of the image with excellent global property. This paper provides the calculus and experiments of the algorithm which show the accuracy of 1 pixel.

articleTitle: Study on Spectrum Allocation of Primary Users for Cognitive Radio Based on Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: The lending spectrum behavior of primary users in cognitive radio is analyzed using game theory. Firstly, the system model of spectrum allocation is established. Secondly, based on the system model, Cournot algorithm is designed. Finally, simulation is done for the situation that the total quantity and the price of the lending spectrum vary with the increasing of the number of the primary users. The simulation results show that the lending spectrum quantity has been increased very much and the price of the spectrum has been reduced by using Cournot algorithm compared with the static spectrum allocation algorithm.

articleTitle: A Low Complexity Optimal Bit Allocation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: OWA Algorithm was proposed. OWA gave water filling bit allocation to each sub channel, adjusted bits' number of each sub channel until satisfying efficient character, and used bit-filling or bit-removal procedure under constraint power until satisfying E-tight character, implementing rate maximization. Simulation shows this algorithm implements the same optimal performance as Greedy algorithm but largely decreases complexity and is of the same degree of complexity as Jang, Leke, Krongold algorithms but implements optimal performance.

articleTitle: The Research of Ultrasonic Heat Meter Based on Wireless Backwater Temperature Measurement
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: According to the disadvantages of traditional heat meter and normal ultrasonic heat meter, an ultrasonic heat meter based on wireless backwater temperature measurement was designed. The unit of wireless backwater temperature measurement and the unit of flow and influent temperature measurement which are mutually independent transmit data to each other with wireless communication module. A approximate Σ-Δ A/D scheme based on MSP430F123 micro controller unit on the basis of the principle of Σ-Δ A/D also was proposed in paper. Experiment results demonstrated that measurement error is low when we measure temperature with the method proposed and it can satisfy the required accuracy of temperature measurement while reducing cost.

articleTitle: A New Estimation Method Based on Feature Difference for Coherent Source
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: According to the characteristics of feature difference of the data covariance matrix from uniform antenna array, the authors propose a new method of detecting the number of sources, this method can accurately estimate the number of sources in the following case of high degree of source coherences, and small difference between the incident angles. First, the antenna array data covariance matrix is decoherented, and then use the transformation criterion of characteristic difference for calculating the appropriate threshold, at last use the threshold to determine the number of sources.

articleTitle: Application of Weighted Coding in Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: As the performance of the Mobile Ad-Hoc Networks and Wireless Communication Networks becomes important. The need for better and protected techniques to secure the transmission of information across these networks gathers importance. Among a few number of techniques suggested and implemented so far perhaps one method which has been overlooked is the weighting technique which could be applied to any digital coding techniques used by the wireless networks. In this research application of what is termed as "Weighted Pulse Code Modulation (WPCM)" is considered together with its pros and cons. Implementation of a prototype system and results obtained are analyzed. Simulation results have shown that application of this method could be an effective path in delivering higher and efficient throughput when backbone path of such networks becomes severely constrained.

articleTitle: Evaluation Mechanism for Web Service Based on Semantics and Reputation
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In open network, unfamiliar web services are unavailable due to lack of effective mechanism to evaluation their performances for users. In order to help the user recognizing unknown web services, semantics understanding and reputation based evaluation mechanism is introduced into web service research. Semantics understanding based evaluation is according to the user's requirements semantics and the semantics of candidate web service's capacities. Reputation ranking method is proposed to build up a neutral and whole belief about a web service. Web service reputation is composed by two facets: time limitation and ranking delay. Finally, the experiment shows that our approach is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: A Security Registration Based on IPSec for Mobile IPv6 Fast Handoff
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: At present, many studies focus on the efficiency of handoff among different networks, while research on how to maintain the safety during registration process of handoff is not enough. Unfortunately, mobile node is vulnerable to various security threats and attacks when handover for being lack of protection. A security scheme based on the IPSec protocol which was combined with fast handoff signaling was given in this paper. The mutual handover authentication between mobile nodes and access routers was obtained through improved handoff signaling, and IPSec security association was used to protect the handoff process without lowering its efficiency.

articleTitle: A New Routing Algorithm Based on Hotlinks
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: A new multi-paths routing algorithm has been proposed in this paper, which can solve the problem of congestion caused by overloads of links and provide a better environment compared with the traditional networking technologies. This methodology will call the routing mechanism when the links appear overloads, and it can adopt alternative path or multi-paths to complete data transmission to reduce congestion. Finally, the experiment results show that the algorithm can improve the throughput, decrease the packet loss ratio comparing to single path system, and achieve a new balance.

articleTitle: A New Multi-Dimensional Mapping of QPSK Constellation for BICM-ID Systems
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In this paper, a new multi-dimensional mapping of QPSK constellation is proposed to improve the performance for bit interleaved coded modulation with iteratively decoding (BICM-ID) systems. Based on analyzing the relationship between Hamming distance and Euclidean distance of QPSK symbols, we find that the Euclidean distance between that pair of signals whose labels differ only in one bit is obtained from Hamming distance, and it takes the Hamming distance as rule of designing and optimizing multi-dimensional mapping of QPSK constellation and gives the search steps and result of multi-dimensional mapping. Analysis and simulation results show that the new scheme achieves the better performance than the conventional two-dimensional and multi-dimensional mapping of QPSK constellation at high SNR in BICM-ID systems.

articleTitle: The Influence of Phase Sequence Distribution on PAPR of OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: One major drawback associated with orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) technique is the high peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) of the transmitted signal. By introducing the weighting phase sequence which contains a set of phase factors called as side information, Partial transmit sequence (PTS) and selected mapping (SLM) schemes both provide good performance for PAPR reduction. In this paper, we investigate the influence of the weighted phase sequence distribution of the side information on PAPR. Computer simulation results show that the closer side information approach to uniform distribution, the better PAPR performance can get, especially when the phase sequence subjects to uniform distribution has best PAPR reduction performance while normal distributed phase sequence leads to the worst performance on PAPR reduction.

articleTitle: The Analysis and Design of Security Protocol on Electrical Business Platform
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: This paper focuses on communication security of e-commerce. A secure electronic transaction model was designed, with the designs of security protocols of transactions for each process in detail, and the advantages was pointed out. In the design process, the security protocol proposed in this paper is not confined to a particular electronic trading system itself. This model has a wide range of practical significance and reference value.

articleTitle: A New Network Coding Structure and Its Application on CERNET Backbone
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: This paper proposes a new ring structure of network coding (RSNC) based on existing network coding topology, enlarging the field of application and reducing the complexity of coding. On the basis of real-time monitoring and dynamic allocation for network bandwidth, RSNC is applied to the CERNET backbone network. The route of the packet is decided by the source node when it sends data packet and it is written into the packet header. The intermediate node retransmits following this route. When the network topology changes, the whole network topology will be updated, and the sparse routing tree of the whole network will be sent. Hence, each node knows the connection relationship of the whole network. NS simulation result indicates that utilization of the ring topology structure we proposed can realize the network coding and improve the network throughput rate and utilization rate of bandwidth.

articleTitle: A Novel Cross-Section Imaging Method from Three-Dimensional Cardiac Point Cloud with Interpolation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In clinic diagnosis, the calculation of the arbitrary cross-section of the living organisms is useful and important. In this paper, one novel method of calculate the arbitrary cross-section of three-dimensional cardiac is present, we use a method of Backward Projection calculate the coordinate of each point in the cross-section, takes into account the shape and geometry of the reconstructed object from a set of slices. As coordinate is known, linear interpolation is adopted to calculate the RGB value of all pixels. The result indicates that using the method present, we can get clip plane on random orientation, with high precision.

articleTitle: Lossless Image Compression Based on Integer Wavelet Transform and Context Prediction
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In this paper, we analyze the correlation between wavelet coefficients. In order to use both inter-band and intra-band correlation, we build context prediction model for significance and refinement bits. Combining with sign bit prediction model of JPEG2000, we propose a lossless image compression algorithm. Compression experimental results show that our algorithm outperforms both JPEG2000 and JPEG-LS international standard.

articleTitle: Obstacle Avoidance and Path Planning Based on S-Type Double-Arc Insertion Method
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: This paper propose an S-Type Double-Arc insertion method for automatic needle insertion in path planning with obstacle avoidance, which is based upon the research of path planning in the case of an obstacle appears between needle and target. Through the evaluation of the relative position among the needle, obstacle and target, using their tangent lines, an approach which combines global and local path planning was presented. With inserting a needle along the arcs of a contour line inscribed polygon, and approaching the necessary algorithm of obstacle avoidance for automatic needle insert with a minimum cost(to minimize the pain of patients), in order to improve the applicability for path planning of automatic needle insertion.

articleTitle: Potential Function Agglomeration Clustering Algorithm for Sparse Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In this paper, the Potential Function Agglomeration Clustering (PFAC) algorithm has been proposed for estimating the mixing matrix in underdetermined Sparse Component Analysis (SCA), wherein the number of mixtures is less than the number of the sources. In contrast to many existing SCA methods, the PFAC algorithm can accurate estimate the number of sources and the mixing matrix. The algorithm also exhibits two robust characteristics: (1) robust to the additive noise and outliers; (2) robust to the source signals are insufficient sparsity. The simulation results show the validity of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Correlated Noise Reduction Algorithm for Multichannel Leak Signal
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Wavelet transform is well know by its sparse representation of signals, with application to separate the noise from signals. Wavelet transform is appropriate to multichannel signal denoising, we consider the spatially correlation between noises and develop a new correlated noise reduction algorithm. This method is based on a change of basis that is obtained from the diagonalization of a robust estimator of the noise covariance matrix. Classical test signals were simulated to analysis the performance of the algorithm. Experiments show it outperforms the primitive wavelet transform on the one dimentional signal situations. Four channel signals are obtained from the oil pipeline leak detection project. We apply multivariate denoising to these signals and this provide denoised signals for the next step of leak recognize and time delay estimation.

articleTitle: The Spectrum Solutions of Cognitive Radios with a Signaling Channel
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: This paper discusses the spectrum solutions of cognitive radios with a signaling channel. The scheme, which has a simple structure, could provide not only effective spectrum allocation, but also powerful spectrum management. The aim is to introduce solutions which can support different bandwidths for a large number of consumers and at the cost of simple modifications on the same hardware platform. Such structures have previously been used for mobile communication systems and the paper aims to discuss their possible applications in the context of cognitive radios. The solutions have excellent reliability, and might make the best of licensed spectrum.

articleTitle: Avian Micro-Doppler Feature Extraction Based on Frequency-Stepped Chirp ISAR
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Avian detection is very important for the security and development of human's aviation as well as the development of avian ecology and the prevention from avian influenza. In this paper, a new method of avian micro-Doppler feature extraction from spectrogram on the range-slow time plane based on frequency-stepped chirp ISAR is proposed. In the method, the micro-Doppler outline can be obtained to extract the micro-Doppler rotation frequency and magnitude. The feasibility and effectiveness of the method is proved by simulation results.

articleTitle: Study on the Principle of CDMA Mode in TD-SCDMA
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: The principle of CDMA mode in TD-SCDMA(TD), which means how spectrum spreading and scrambling code being used in TD is a basic problem. Comparing with the other two 3G standards, the principle and realization of the CDMA mode used in TD standard has much difference. Both cdma2000 and FDD WCDMA use the CDMA mode of real spectrum spreading and complex scrambling code, which is the traditional concept of spectrum spreading and scrambling code. While there are the principle and realization of complex spectrum spreading, weighted coefficient and dedicated complex scrambling code in TD, which would be explained in this paper. Also the implementation circuit and performance analysis of the CDMA mode used in TD would be presented in this paper.

IEEE Keywords: Time division synchronous code division multiple access

articleTitle: Application of Hilbert-Huang Transform to Blasting Vibration Signal Feature Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: A new method based on Hilbert-Huang Transform (HHT) is proposed to analyze the blast vibration signal in this paper. Energy-frequency-time distribution of the signal can be established though EMD (empirical mode decomposition) and Hilbert transform, from which Hilbert energy spectrum is obtained. The energy spectrum is applied to indicate the energy distribution of the signal on the frequency axis. The variation of blast vibration with time changing is researched by using instantaneous energy. Feasibility of the method has already been verified by the blast engineering test.

articleTitle: Study on the Applicability of PJ Model on Part Coastal Sea of China
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: The theories of evaporation duct and Paulus-Jeske model were briefly described, at the same time the methods of measuring the evaporation duct on the sea were introduced. In order to study the applicability of Paulus-Jeske model in coastal sea, the distribution of duct height errors and duct strength errors calculated by Paulus-Jeske model on different distance sections off the shore was analyzed, using the refraction index profiles and offshore hydrometeorology data collected experimentally in sea areas near the shore in recent years. The results could be took as reference for the studies on the detection of targets over the horizon on the sea with radar on the shore.

articleTitle: Research on the Radiation Field of Wide-Band Leaky Coaxial Cable
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Recently, leaky coaxial cable plays a more and more important role in every kind of blind or semi-blind zone mobile communication, and along with the increase of communication business, the number of frequency band increases, lager communication capacity is needed, so it is necessary to extend the frequency band of leaky coaxial cable. The method of extending the frequency band of leaky coaxial cable is studied in this paper, and the radiation field of leaky coaxial cable whose frequency band is extended is simulated, the results show the relationship between band extending and radiation characteristics.

articleTitle: Improved Fair Scheduling Mechanism in Distributed WiMAX Mesh Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In Distributed WiMAX Mesh Networks (DWMN), a joint solution with FEBA (Fair End-to-end Bandwidth Allocation) and DRR (Deficit Round Robin) can be used to achieve high end-to-end throughput fairness. Even then, the higher the number of hops a traffic flow traverses, the longer becomes the end-to-end delay of the traffic flow. This will result in serious unfairness of service quality among real-time traffic flows with different path length since they are delay-sensitive. In this paper, an improved fair scheduling mechanism based on the previous joint solution is proposed to deal with the above-mentioned problem by assigning a greater scheduling weight to the relayed traffic flows. Moreover, a new fairness index is defined to evaluate the service quality fairness of traffic flows. The proposed mechanism is compared with the previous joint solution by simulation. The results indicate that our proposed mechanism can provide better service quality fairness among real-time traffic flows without decreasing their throughput fairness. And it is also effective to improve the service quality fairness and throughput fairness of non-real-time traffic flows when the network is under a certain load.

articleTitle: Cooperative Relay Using Erasure Codes for Reliable Data Transport in Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Providing efficient and reliable data transport is a challenging problem for a variety of emerging applications which require reliable data packet delivery in wireless networks. In this paper, we propose to incorporate erasure codes at transport layer in the notion of cooperative relay communications to provide reliability and robustness for data transport in wireless networks. Our basic idea is to exploit the joint merits of erasure codes and cooperative relay communications. We design two cooperative relay strategies with different implementation complexity and analyze their performance based on a general 3-node relay model. Numerical results show that our proposed approach can achieve significant performance improvement in terms of data transport efficiency. In addition, the proposed approach exhibits strong robustness to packet losses on wireless links for data transfer.

articleTitle: A Novel Image Denoising Method Using Independent Component Analysis and Dual-Tree Complex Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: This paper presents a novel adaptive method of image denoising based on the dual-tree complex wavelet transform (DT-CWT) and independent component analysis (ICA). This method extracts the high-frequency component of the image with the DT-CWT, then combining with the principle of ICA virtual observed noise channel denoise. It does not need a lot of observed image samples, and it is unnecessary to know the detail of the observed image signal type in advance. A single observed image could be denoised by this method adaptively. Moreover, it overcomes the deficiency in wavelet threshold denoising, that is the selective and the quantitive of threshold. The experimental results show that this algorithm denoises the image effectively, improving the SNR (signal noise ratio) & PSNR (peak signal nose ratio) largely and retaining the original image information better.

articleTitle: Challenges and Experiences of Building Multimedia Transmission Testbeds in Wireless Mesh Network
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Wireless mesh networks (WMN), with static wireless back-bone and multi-hop communication, as protocols typically employed in WMN are, for the most part, not designed for real-time communications. WMNs experimentation is subjected to stochastic factors such as channel contention, interference, node mobility and access latency add delay and degrade the quality of the stream, pose new design challenges. In this paper, we report on our effort and experience to design our WMN testbed. As a case study, second, we introduce the TJU MeshNet architecture. We share our lessons learned from this effort and believe that they will be valuable to other researchers who develop experimental wireless mesh networks and business applications.

articleTitle: A Novel Method for Recognising Radar Emitter
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: A novel method for recognising radar emitter is proposed in this paper. The resemblance coefficient (CR), pulse repetition interval (PRI) mean and variance are used as the factors for recognising radar emitter which is based on the feature of these parameters. Then, the radial basis probabilistic neural networks (RBPNN) recognition is designed. Simulation experiment shows that this novel method can improve the recognition rate while it can also improve the recognition velocity.

articleTitle: Prediction of Wetland Vegetation Distribution in Hongze Lake
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Freshwater wetlands in Hongze Lake play a significant role in the local ecological balance. Therefore the state-level Jiangsu Sihong Hongze Lake Ecological Reserve has been established for the protection of rare birds and their habitats in the lake. Wetland in the lake has been changing in the past 30 years. The information on the change trends of the wetlands is important to the management of the reserve. In the paper, logistic model has been used for the prediction of wetland vegetation distribution in Hongze Lake. Field data on soil, water depth and the occurrences of wetland vegetation were collected in September, 1998. Slope data were derived from DEM of the study area. Then the logistic model was used to explore the relationship between the presence of wetland vegetation and biophysical variables. Then the model was used for the prediction of the wetland vegetation distribution of Hongze Lake in 2000. The Landsat 7 ETM+ acquired on September 16, 2000 was used for the classification of the wetland vegetation. The classification results of imagery of 2000 were compared with the results of the model prediction. The comparison showed that 87.3% of wetland vegetation predicted by the model matched the classification results of ETM+ imagery.

articleTitle: Two-Level Spreading OFDM System Using Beamforming and Adaptive Code Assignment for Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Orthogonal frequency division multiple (OFDM) system with two-level spreading is an effective approach to suppress interference in wireless communication. However, in this system, the orthogonality of its spreading code can be destroyed by multipath fading. In this paper, we propose a novel resource allocation scheme that joints conventional two-level spreading OFDM and smart antenna so as to use beamforming to decrease multiuser interference in spatial domain. In order to achieve further interference suppression, we assign a proper spreading code at the transmitter and employ the zero-forcing equalizer at the receiver. Simulation results show that the new scheme is capable of achieving a significant improvement of efficiency for interference suppressing under multipath fading and jamming channels.

articleTitle: Cooperative Routing in Multi-Hop Networks over Nakagami-m Channels
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In this paper, the amount of energy saving is studied in cooperative multi-hop wireless sensor networks with the constraint of a given outage probability. In these networks, each node transmits its signal to the next m_coop nodes on the route ending with the sink node. Nakagami channels are considered. Numerical results show that the purposed cooperative routing can provide considerable energy saving compared to that of non-cooperative multi-hop transmission. Results show that the proposed network achieves up to 74% energy saving in Nakagami-2 channels when the optimum number of m_coop is four with the maximum outage probability of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup>.

articleTitle: Orthogonal Vector Estimation Algorithm Based on Signal Subspace with General Correlation Matrix
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Many popular spectral estimation methods, such as Prony, MUSIC, Linear Prediction etc., may fall into the same mathematic problem of extracting signal embedded within noise. In this paper, an improved spectral estimation with general matrix form is proposed, i.e. Orthogonal Vector Spectral Estimation based on Signal Subspace (OVSESS). Since OVSESS is a kind of orthogonal vector, the improved spectral estimation is achieved based on the capability to distinguish signal frequencies. Therefore, the better stabilization in different conditions of SNR (signal to noise ratio ),can be achieved ,results show that higher robustness and efficiency with signal estimation procedure is obtained by using the improved spectral estimation algorithm with the OVSESS.

articleTitle: A Replica Location Method Based on Huffman Encode in Mobile Grid
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: A major problem in mobile computing is the optimal replication and location of data files in the Grid sites, in order to improve and maintain over time a high overall throughput of Grid jobs that access files. Therefore, a Grid optimization service should be able to dynamically modify the geographic distribution of data files, triggering file replication and location, according to the variation over time of the sites where data is highly requested. In this document we propose a new decentralized replica location method based on Huffman encode in mobile Grids. In this method replica location index information are spread on index nodes according to the locality of the index nodes or the frequency of being accessed of the index nodes based on Huffman encode. Meanwhile it employs replica location nodes to support local query for local replicas. This method is simple to use and it has locality.

articleTitle: Reduced State Sequence Detection for Ring Convolutional Coded Continuous Phase Modulation
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: The detection of convolutional codes over rings suitable for continuous phase modulation (CPM) are presented based on the Rimoldi's Decomposition of CPM. Because the ring convolutional codes are on the same ring as the inner codes of CPM, We can use reduced state sequence detection (RSSD) to analyze and detect the overall encoder. Numerical result shows the detection complexity of this RSSD is significantly reduced with a very small degradation in error performance.

articleTitle: An Improved Peak Extraction Algorithm in PHD Based Multi-Target Tracking Algorithm Applied to Passive Radar
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: To extract the target location correctly in PHD based multi-target tracking algorithm, an improved peak extraction algorithm was proposed. This new algorithm stemmed from the CLEAN technique in radar signal processing. By finding the highest peak in every iteration, the assumed target was extracted and its corresponding location information was obtained. Simulation results prove the efficiency and correctness of this new algorithm.

articleTitle: Multifractal Detrended Fluctuation Analysis of Network Traffic
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Whether network traffic in fine scales (below about 1 second) behaves multifractality is controversial in past studies. In recent years, the multifractal detrended fluctuation analysis (MFDFA) is widely used as a robust tool to investigate the scale behavior of non-stationary time series. In this paper, we use MFDFA to review the numerical evidence of multifractality in network traffic. By carefully examining the scale behavior of four campus traffic set, we demonstrate multifractality does exist, even for UDP traffic series. In addition, we find the general two types of multifractality, (I) the multifractality due to a broad probability density function for values of the time series, and (II) the multifractality due to different long-range (time-)correlations of the small and large fluctuations, can not completely explain the multifractality in network traffic series.

articleTitle: Vehicle Surface Affection on Antenna Polarization
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: The advantage of short-wave communication in the present regional wars and the rescue in the field is over microwave communication so the NVIS (the vertical incidence short-wave antenna) antenna is proposed and HF communication in blind-spot is becoming more and more important. As NVIS antenna is fixed on vehicles, the electric polarization must be impacted by the antenna height, vehicles surface dielectric constant, vehicles surface conductivity. The paper focuses on the vehicles surface reflection factors to reveal. Therefore we must consider the antenna and Vehicles as all in the design of vehicle mobile antenna.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Partial Feedback Scheme of Resource Allocation in OFDMA Systems
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: The adaptive resource allocation will be a key technique of the OFDMA systems in the future wireless networks due to the great improvement of the network throughput. However, in order to allocate the subcarriers and power adaptively, the users need to send back the channel state information (CSI) periodically to the base station. The feedback overhead is huge, and it brings a big burden to the uplink systems. In this paper, we focus on the partial CSI feedback scheme of the adaptive resource allocation in the OFDMA systems. A hybrid feedback scheme based on the 1-bit feedback and best-n mechanism is proposed to enhance the efficiency of the feedback overhead. The simulation results show that the proposed mechanism can achieve a good tradeoff between the system throughput and the feedback overhead.

articleTitle: Implementation and Optimization of Orthogonal Pairing Algorithm in WiMAX
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Pairing algorithm is the key to uplink (UL) virtual Multiple Input-Multiple Output (V-MIMO) systems. Orthogonal pairing algorithm is more effective than most of other existing pairing algorithms. However, in real-life systems, e.g. Worldwide Interoperability for Microwave Access (WiMAX), it's impossible to calculate orthogonality of two Mobile Stations (MSs) on their shared subcarriers directly, which is the most troublesome problem of orthogonal pairing algorithm. Based on WiMAX distributed subcarrier allocation mode, we propose a feasible way to resolve the above problem. Our proposed way utilizes the characteristic of pseudo-randomization of WiMAX distributed subcarrier allocation mode and avoids direct computation of orthogonality of two MSs on their shared subcarriers. The correctness of our proposal is verified by two simulation experiments.

articleTitle: A Simple TD-SCDMA DOA Detection Method by the Mid-Amble
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Taking TD-SCDMA system as an example, this paper would give the MDOA method to extract array manifold from smart antenna (SA) receiver directly by utilizing the feature of mid-amble sequence, which is easier to be implemented than those classic methods used for the detection of DOA. Another prominent advantage of the method is that the number of DOA can be detected is not limited to that of array elements. In TD-SCDMA system, there are two dedicated orthogonal mid-amble sequences to be sent for every CDMA channel, and how to produce these two dedicated orthogonal mid-amble sequences is also presented in the paper. The simulation result is given to prove the correctness of the MDOA method.

articleTitle: Concatenated LDPC and Differential Space-Time Block Codes
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a multi-antenna system concatenated Low-density Parity-check (LDPC) codes and Differential Space-time Block codes (DSTBC), in which channel state information (CSI) is unknown to the transmitter and the receiver. The system performance is given through computer simulation, we can see that the proposed system not only provides transmit diversity gain but also coding gain.

articleTitle: Research on Timestamp Synchronization for Network Confrontation
