publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: SIP-based instant messaging (IM) is currently a quite hot issue in the SIP world. Two approaches, pager-mode IM and session-mode IM, have been explored for implementation. This paper provides an in-depth analysis of the first method through an example, and makes improvement to the second by presenting specific signaling and media messages. Solutions to security problems are also discussed in detail for the two methods, respectively.

articleTitle: A Trusted Authorization Scheme for E-Commerce Systems
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: The trusted authorization scheme is core content of e-commerce. Authorization refers to a kind of mechanism that specific authenticated users can access secure resources. Authorization system relies on the authentication system to confirm the identity of legitimate users and prevent unauthorized users. In order to solve the trusted problem of authorization, TPM1.2 specification published by TCG organization contains a series of protocols to resist all forms of attack. However, there are some security flaws in these protocols. A new trusted authorization protocol securer than OIAP protocol is proposed in the paper. The scheme ensures that only if the returned message is received and identified by the application the authorized access can be executed. This make the subject is credible when accessing key data in the trusted terminal and this can ensure the credibility of the e-commerce transactions. The security of the scheme is analyzed using formal logic method.

articleTitle: P-persistent CSMA Protocol Simulation Based on ON/OFF Source Model in Cognitive Radio Network
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In this paper, we discuss a p-persistent CSMA protocol based on-off source model in a cognitive radio network. Then the system model for primary user and cognitive user is analyzed in cognitive radio network, which using discrete event-driven simulation scheme. The article demonstrates various results such as cognitive user packet dropping probability and channel utilization rate, according to different values of p. The result shows that according to the network loading dynamically adjust the values of p can reduce the network collision probability and avoid network congestion. This paper offers a reference to the choice of p.

articleTitle: Experiment and Model of Geometric Rectification on SPOT5 Imagery under Lack Control Points
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In this paper, taking SPOT5 HRG as an example, multi-parameter interpolation methods is firstly built by analyzing ephemeris data and a rigorous physical geometry imaging model is derived. Taking the case of images in Kunming area, image rectification experiment was then performed using no control point and lack control points. Eventually, the experimental results are analyzed in details.

articleTitle: A New Phase Noise Mitigation Algorithm for MIMO-OFDM Communications Systems
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Applying multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) techniques to orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) systems promise to achieve high spectral efficiency. However, similar to single antenna OFDM systems, phase noise drastically degrades the performance of such systems. In this paper, we investigate the influence of phase noise in MIMO-OFDM wireless systems and propose a new algorithm for joint phase noise estimation and data symbols detection. Simulation results illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm on improving the symbol error rate (SER) of MIMO-OFDM systems.

articleTitle: An E-Cash Payment Protocol Realizing Accountability and Fairness
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: The paper proposes an improvement of e-cash payment protocol. One improvement is to divide the "agreement" and "use" of the session key into two stages, which ensures its key confidentiality. The second improvement is that the identities of the merchants are proved by their electronic certificates, which realizes its non-repudiation. The third improvement is that the payment receipts are transmitted by the trusted party, which avoids unfairness arisen by the dishonest entities. In addition, the protocol uses FTP to transmit e-cashes and payment receipts, which can ensure achievement of accountability and fairness, and enhance the robustness. The proposed protocol is verified to satisfy accountability and fairness by utilizing the improved Kailar logic.

articleTitle: A New MMSE Estimator Based on Signal Correlation Property
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: An improved minimum mean square error (MMSE) estimate method based on the diversity of correlation characteristic between the additive white noise and the signal is proposed in this presentation. The new estimator is constructed as a linear combination of the covariance matrices of the observed signal and its delay. The proofing and simulation indicate that the new estimator can achieve a better estimate than the traditional MMSE estimator.

articleTitle: Research on QoS of Streams with Different Parameters in Wireless Network
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: It is difficult to provide QoS guarantees for streams in wireless network based on IEEE802.11 DCF because of limited bandwidth. Taking CBR traffic as example, we studied the traffic performance with different parameters in this paper. The results show that for an overloaded network, the traffic with longer packet size has greater throughput. Since the MAC layer performs the same competitive algorithm, the node in the same competitive environment has almost the same capacity to occupy the channel. Then, the traffic with longer packet size can send more data in the occupied channel. The greater throughput is gained. Based on this conclusion, we can differentiate traffics by setting different parameters to improve QoS of traffic in an overloaded network.

articleTitle: A New Algorithm to Approximate Deforming Models Based on Torsion Detection
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new method to approximate deforming models based on torsion detection. We propose the use of surface torsion to represent local features on the original model, and consider it as an additional weight factor when calculating the edge contraction cost during the simplification process. The approximations of the original deforming models are generated progressively from the first frame to the last one. Based on the edge contraction sequence in the previous frame, the contraction order in the current frame is adjusted according to the deformation degree. Our approach is fast, easy to implement, and as a result good quality approximations with well-preserved fine details can be generated at any given frame.

articleTitle: Two-Round Cooperation Based Spectrum Sensing in Cognitive Radio Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Cooperative spectrum sensing is a fast and effective approach to improve sensing performance in cognitive radio networks. However, in order to reduce the bandwidth demands of cooperation, censoring is needed. In this paper, we propose a Two-Round Cooperation based Spectrum Sensing algorithm (TRCSS) according to local three-threshold decision results. More specifically, after the first round censoring failed, cognitive users begin to report the second local decision bits to fusion center to proceed the second round cooperation, thus sensing failure is eliminated. Furthermore, integrating uncertainty of noise variance, we propose a simple method to set local decision threshold values. Numerical results show that TRCSS algorithm does not significantly increase the number of sensing bits, especially with much cooperative users. In addition, the complementary ROC curves demonstrate that the TRCSS algorithm is superior to the conventional double-threshold sensing methods in performance.

articleTitle: An Implementation to Mitigate the Effect of Multipath on Positioning Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In the process of satellite positioning measurement, channel's multipath causes error of positioning. Researches show that multipath will have no effect on positioning accuracy when delays are more than 1 chip away from line of sight signal. A method proposed to extract estimation of multipath delay which is lower than 1 chip, attenuation and phase from the code generator data, local oscillator data and received signal data provided by ordinary loop locked receiver. The method has a robust characteristic under low carrier to noise ratio environment. And also simulation results are provided. Using known pseudo-random-code auto-correlation function, estimation of multipath delay can be further precisely searched. The simulation shows that in most cases the accuracy is within the sampling interval of the known pseudo-random-code auto-correlation function.

articleTitle: Minimize the Secret Storage - A New Economical Scheme for Identifying Low-Cost RFID Tags
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) system brings us many advantages, but the security and privacy problems are the impediment to the increasing using of it, particularly to the low-cost one. In order to solve this problem economically, we manage to design a new scheme for low-cost passive RFID tags based on the cryptographic techniques. Considering the ID should be regarded as a secret when facing with the user's privacy, the proposed scheme employs the ID as the only share secret between the tag and the back-end database, defines a lightweight function by using of simple operators, uses these and mutual authentication mechanism to reach our goal. After designing of our scheme, the security and performance analysis is also given, it shows that it can not only minimize the storage resource, reduce the computational resource of the low-cost RFID tag, but also achieve the secure and private goals.

articleTitle: The Research on Protocol for Wireless Sensor Network Based on muC/OS-II Operating System
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: To improve communication reliability and protocols'portability on the nodes of wireless sensor network and ease the development difficulty, a new system design scheme based on the embedded operating system μC/OS-II is proposed in this paper. According to operating system modular design strategy, the way of task partitioning for network protocol stack is present and the operating system is transplanted on the LPC2138. An analysis about error data acknowledgement on data link layer was also put up, together with a corresponding improvement. The experiment shows that, basing on the operating system, the protocol stack runs smoothly, reliably. What's more, the platform meets the applications of location etc.

articleTitle: A Frequency Estimation Algorithm for Pulsed Magnetron Radar Transmitter Sample Signal
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: the pulsed magnetron Cloud sounding radar is one of non-coherent radar, a magnetron has a random starting phase and its frequency chirps during the transmit pulse. This paper presents a frequency estimation algorithm for pulsed magnetron radar transmitter sample signal, based on the modified Wigner-Ville time-frequency analysis. From the three groups' data of compared simulation experiment, at any condition, this paper method can get higher performance than FFT method, and can get measurement mean error less than 0.105% at low algorithm complexity. The method can be used as frequency discriminator in pulsed magnetron Cloud sounding radar AFC real-time hardware system.

articleTitle: A Low-Complexity Diversity Scheme for SIMO OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: The complexity of the conventional post Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) Maximal Ratio Combining may exceed the processing ability of a low-end OFDM receiver. In this paper, we propose a new combining architecture which can reduce the complexity by using cyclic delay combining and orthogonal design simultaneously. Simulation results show that this architecture works well in the OFDM system.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation and Optimization of Backward and Bi-Directionally Pumped Raman Amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In this paper, the optimization method of pump configuration is summarized for backward and bi-directionally pumped Raman amplifiers. Moreover, the power distribution of pumps, 100-channel optical signals, ASE and DRBS is simulated and demonstrated in detail, and DRBS noise power is far less than ASE noise power. For the bidirectional pumping scheme, less than 0.5 dB flatness of both gain and OSNR is realized within 80nm gain bandwidth by optimizing pump wavelengths and pump powers. On the contrary, if a backward pumping RA is optimally designed for having a flattened broadband gain spectrum, then its' OSNR profile must be tilted, and shorter wavelength signals have experienced greater change magnitude than longer wavelength signals.

articleTitle: Attemper Arithmetic of Heterogeneous Wireless Network Classification Queue Basing on Multimedium Operation Division Service
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Allusion to the various different requirements QoS's quota such as delay sensitivity of multi-medium business for Multi-media communication in Heterogeneous wireless network, we put forward the attemper arithmetic of classify queue based on multi-medium communication. Grade the now operation according to the factors of flux, delay and error tolerance etc, and the node that participates transmission forming a line to process according to the grade and network condition, and satisfies many kinds of multi-medium business at the same time. The simulation experiment proved the effectiveness of algorithm.

articleTitle: An Adaptive RED Algorithm Based on q Weight
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: This paper analyzes the deficiency of the average queue calculation in tradition RED queue, and presents a calculation algorithm for the calculation of RED's average queue based on the current network conditions in order to enhance the self-adaptation of RED and we use NS2 for the simulation. Experimental results show that the improved RED performances better than tradition RED in the middle congestion and above, and in the case of low congestion the both are almost the same.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of MIMO MRC with M-ary Orthogonal and Biorthogonal Signaling in Rayleigh Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: The performance of multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) maximal ratio combining (MRC) systems in Rayleigh fading channels is investigated in this paper. The new exact closed-form expressions for the average bit error rate (BER) of coherent M-ary orthogonal and biorthogonal signals are derived. A simple and accurate approximate solution for the average BER of coherent M-ary orthogonal signals is also presented. Numerical results are presented to verify the accuracy of the solution. The approximate solution can be used to compute the average BER of M-ary orthogonal signals for MIMO MRC systems.

articleTitle: Approaching MAC Capacity via Power Allocation
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: A method to approach the capacity of Multiple Access Channel by means of power allocation was studied. By applying PAM modulation to each individual signal and superimposing the weighted signal together, we treated MAC channel as single user multiple level coding and modulation system. We found that the searched power profile was more powerful in terms of approaching MAC capacity than that obtained by equal power allocation and by Interior-Point Method (IPM), especially in the case of 4 users. The optimized power profile shows that at low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) region the performance gain is negligible, while in high SNR region, it is noted. The optimized power profile can be used to facilitate the performance of channel coding.

articleTitle: A New FMT System Structure with Relative Coding
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new FMT scheme based on relative coding which makes the adjacent inter-symbol interference adjustable. Compared with the traditional scheme, the new scheme has better subchannel pulse response and better power spectrum. Simulation results show that the new scheme has better immunity to inter-symbol interference and better constellation performance.

articleTitle: The Analysis of BER Performance of Implicit Diversity in Frequency Selective Fading
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: The frequency selective fading in the troposcatter channel deforms the signal spectrum and may give rise to intersymbol interference, but if taking some measures, the effect of the diversity would be available by using the characteristic, that is implicit diversity. As yet, the performance of the implicit diversity has not been analytically measurable. In this paper, a model is built, and through the model, the analysis on the performance of the implicit diversity is made for the typical frequency correlation characteristics in the troposcatter channel. The calculation method is verified by computer simulation, and the result is substantially useful to guide the engineering design.

articleTitle: FPGA Implementation of a Reed-Solomon CODEC for OTN G.709 Standard with Reduced Decoder Area
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: The Reed-Solomon error correction code is widely used in digital telecommunication systems, including satellite communications and data recording systems such as CD and DVD. This article presents an implementation for the encoder and the decoder of optical communication systems, according to the ITU-T G.709 standard. It presents an approach that multiplexes the traditional decoder blocks. The implementation promotes an expressive area reduction in an FPGA. It also presents the circuit implementation in a Virtex 5 FPGA, using software Xilinx ISE 10.1 tools.

articleTitle: Image Segmentation Algorithm Based on Improved Visual Attention Model and Region Growing
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: The essence of image segmentation is a based on some properties the process for pixel classification. Firstly, three typical methods in image segmentation methods are outlined and their characteristic is analyzed in this paper. The traditional visual attention model is described and improved in this paper. The input image gray value and edge features are extracted by Gabor filters and the Gauss - Laplace operator, gray feature maps and the edge feature maps are got respectively, then interest regions image is obtained by linear combination. The interest region in interest region image is selected by the dynamic neural network methods in artificial intelligence. The limit scope of regional growth is provided improved visual attention model algorithm identified interest region, the binary image is got by setting gray-value. At last, image segmentation is achieved by image segmentation algorithm based improved visual attention model and region growing. Experimental results validate that this methods not only achieve image segmentation, but also accurately and automatically achieve interest region segmentation, improve the quality of the segmentation, and has good robustness.

articleTitle: Illumination Invariant Enhancement and Threshold Segmentation Algorithm for Asphalt Pavement Crack Image
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: The non-uniform illumination and irregularities in the surface of asphalt pavement make the conventional image enhancement and segmentation algorithm fail. In order to address these problems, we present an illumination invariant image enhancement and segmentation algorithm, which are crucial for feature extraction and classification of pavement crack image. The experimental results based on measured image by CCD camera on vehicle show that the presented algorithm is very effective for the illumination invariant and the irregularities in the surface of asphalt pavement.

articleTitle: Capacity Analysis of VoIP Service in Cognitive Radio System
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In this paper, we study the VoIP capacity in cognitive radio system. As the cognitive user, VoIP packets arrival from a poisson process and use the wireless channels transparently. We formulate the whole dispose procedure as a birth and death processes, and establish preemptive multi-channel model under the consideration of delay and dropping rate constraints to analysis the capacity of VoIP service in the cognitive radio system. The theoretical capacity can be calculated by the system model, furthermore a real simulink system is established by matlab to prove the correctness of our theoretical values.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Canny Detector with New Differential Operator
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: A new Canny detector is proposed, which adopts both new differential operator and adaptive selection of double thresholds. One contribution of this paper is the new differential operator which evolves from quadratic Taylor expansion. It has the advantages of first-order differential operator and second-order differential operator. The other contribution is that double thresholds in Canny detector are selected automatically by using Otsu's method based on gradient magnitude histogram. Experiment results show that the new Canny detector could get more weak edges and even locate these edges more accurately than the original one. Moreover, it could find optimal edges adaptively instead of manually. This new Canny detector has remarkable performance when it is applied to images with low contrast, or those images which pursue accurate location of edges.

articleTitle: A Path Selection Scheme Considering Traffic Load for IEEE 802.16j Mobile Multi-Hop Relay Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: We propose an effective path selection considering current traffic load for IEEE 802.16j MMR networks. Previous schemes either consider channel quality or the number of hops in choosing the effective path for traffic to MSs. Our scheme avoids crowded links even though they have high channel quality. Our scheme balances between the channel quality and the current traffic load, aiming at higher fairness of scheduling for the MSs. The simulation results show our scheme achieves higher throughput as well as fairness among MSs.

articleTitle: Adaptive Sum and Difference Beamforming for Monopulse System with Array Antennas
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Adaptive beamforming will distort monopulse ratio curve and influence angle estimation performance of monopulse system with array antennas. A constrained adaptive beamforming algorithm is proposed, which is implemented in a general side-lobe canceller structure. A reduced-rank blocking matrix is constructed to reduce computational complexity, and additional constraints are introduced to maintain the main-lobe of sum and difference patterns. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can suppress interferences effectively and control distortion degree of monopulse ratio curve.

articleTitle: Printed 6-Element Dipole Array Antenna for Omnidirection Applied in WiMAX
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Abstract-A collinear printed 6-element dipole array antenna for WiMAX application is presented. By employing loop-loaded structures, the better omnidirectional coverage is achieved. The array has shown a 7.2% bandwidth (VSWR≤1.5) of center frequency at about 3.5GHz for application in WiMAX. Its performance is relatively stable with 8dBi antenna gain and about ±0.5dBi of the un-roundness on horizontal plane. Design details of the proposed antenna and the results of both simulation and experiment are presented and discussed.

articleTitle: Mutually Orthogonal Sets of Complementary Sequences for Multi-Carrier CDMA Systems
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Based on concatenating iteration, multiple complementary sequence sets which are orthogonal each other are proposed. Each complementary sequence set of the constructed multiple sets is composed of multiple complementary sequences with each complementary sequence containing a flock of element sequences. The complementary sequences in the same complementary sequence set possess ideal auto-correlation and cross-correlation properties while the complementary sequences from different complementary sequence sets have zero cross-correlation value at zero shift, where correlation function of a complementary sequence is equal to the sum of correlation functions of its element sequences. Compared with the tradition complementary sequence set whose set size is smaller than or equal to flock size, the proposed mutually orthogonal sets of complementary sequences (MOSCS) can provide much more complementary sequences since MOSCS comprise multiple sets. As a result, multi-carrier CDMA systems employing MOSCS can accommodate more users.

articleTitle: DOM Generation from Aerial Images Based on Airborne Position and Orientation System
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Based on the traditional indirect method of digital orthophoto map (DOM) generation, a method of DOM generation from aerial images based on airborne position and orientation system (POS) is proposed. First, digital elevation model (DEM) of local area is produced through dense point image matching of aerial images and multi-image intersection by POS data. Second, with the elevation interpolated using XY coordinates in DOM, the image point coordinates are calculated in original images using POS data and translated to scanned coordinates for digital images. At last, gray value interpolation and assignment are carried out to generate DOM. The results are tested using two sets of actual aerial images and the empirical results indicate that it is feasible to produce DOM using POS data. This method has the characteristics of high efficiency and short cycle for mapping. It suits to the needs of emergency response mapping particularly and provides a new way to acquire and update fundamental geographic information quickly.

articleTitle: An Adaptive MIMO Scheme for E-MBMS in Point-to-Multipoint Transmission Mode
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Multimedia Broadcast Multicast Service (MBMS), also called enhanced MBMS (e-MBMS) in LTE terminology, was introduced in the release 6 of the 3GPP standard to deliver multimedia content to a large group of users. The main requirement during the provision of MBMS services is to make an efficient overall usage of radio and network resources. There are two wireless transmission modes defined in LTE, i.e. Point-to-Point (P-t-P) and Point-to-Multipoint (P-t-M) transmission modes. MIMO systems promise high performance gains over conventional single antenna systems. It is expected to be an important component of the LTE particularly for the MBMS. In this paper, an adaptive MIMO scheme for E-MBMS in P-t-M transmission mode is presented and analyzed. Both spatial multiplexing and diversity techniques are focused on. Different spatial techniques are adaptively used depending on the different users' distributions in one MBMS section. Spatial diversity technique is used to enhance signal strength of the cell edge users; and spatial multiplexing technique is used to increase the data rate of the users with good signal strength. Simulation results show that the proposed scheme can improve the BER performance of the cell edge users, and increase the transmit data rate and data throughput.

articleTitle: Research on Secure Scalar Product Protocol and Its' Application
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Secure scalar product protocol is an important fundamental protocol in secure multi-party computation. Serving as a basic building block for many other secure protocols, it is widely used in data mining, statistical analysis and scientific computation. Based on additive homomorphism public key cryptosystem, we develop a new secure scalar product protocol under semi-honest model with low communication complexity which is easy to implement and understanding. Furthermore, we firstly apply it to position relationship decision for privacy preserving space vectors.

articleTitle: Modified Polyphase Filter for Arbitrary Sampling Rate Conversion
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Arbitrary interpolation filters are used to generate new sample values at arbitrary points to replace the existing discrete-time samples. This paper presents a modified polyphase interpolation filter architecture used in sampling rate conversion (SRC). Its novel implementation modification reduced the coefficients storage requirement. The flexible coefficient addressing mode could make the sampling rate converting as arbitrary ratio. And the number of multipliers and adders can be reduced by the serial logic implementation. Results indicate that the proposed algorithm can easily achieve different stopband attenuation performance by changing the interpolation number of polyphase coefficients.

articleTitle: EMD-Based BER Improvement of TH-PPM UWB Signal in AWGN Channel
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: The empirical mode decomposition (EMD) method for analysing nonlinear and non-stationary data has attracted great research interests. Because, the TH-PPM UWB signal which has the property of transient and low probability of intercept (LPI) is non-stationary, in this paper, the EMD method is used to extract the weak impulse radio signal from noisy environment. The noisy TH-PPM UWB signals are decomposed into a finite number of oscillatory modes known as intrinsic mode functions (IMFs) and a residue. Based on different time scale characteristic of the signal and noise, a majority of noise will be removed from signal by proper selection of IMFs. Simulations have demonstrated that an efficient elimination of noise on UWB signal and a great improvement on Bit error rate (BER) are achieved.

articleTitle: Summary of Network RTK Reference Station Ambiguity Determination
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Three different methods of network RTK reference station ambiguity determination are introduced, summarized and evaluated in this paper: The three-step method to determine double-differenced ambiguities resolution of reference station includes wide-lane, narrow-lane ambiguity resolution and the ambiguities resolution of carrier phase L1 and L2. The second method uses Kalman filtering, the C/A code and the ionosphere-free combination to solve wide-lane ambiguitie, and uses multi-path effects of the cyclical weaken multipath C/A code. The ambiguity of carrier phase on L1 band can be quickly fixed using Kalman filtering and ambiguity decorrelation algorithm based on the wide-lane ambiguity solution. The last kind of method is based on regularization principle, the thought of selected weight fitting and precisely known the reference station coordinates, to work out the regularized matrix, which can mitigate the ill-condition of the normal matrix. The relative float ambiguity can be computed only using several epochs' data. Combined with the LAMBDA method, the approach can fix the ambiguity correctly and quickly.

articleTitle: A Novel Method to Estimate IP Traffic Matrix
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Traffic flow is not only short-range dependence shown in traditional models, but also self-similarity and long-range dependence. The coexistence of these made it hard to estimate traffic matrix (TM) by using the modules based on temporal dimension. This paper avoids to establishing models for TM. Using the TM's spatial self-similarity, we expressed TM as a weighted linear combination of the sample OD flows. Compared with previous methods, our method does not only hold the lower estimation errors but also is more robust.

articleTitle: Zero-Forcing Beamforming with Limited Feedback in Coordinated Multi-Point Transmission
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Coordinated Multi-Point transmission and reception (CoMP) technique is a new promising scheme which has been adopted in LTE-Advanced. For the next generation of wireless communication networks, CoMP is mostly required to reduce the inter-cell interference (ICI). It also increases the cell edge user throughput and improves the coverage. Recently, most research work based on precoding with feedback schemes mainly focuses on explicit feedback in the downlink CoMP. However the feedback type needs a high overhead, resulting in large information exchanged between the eNodeB and the users. In order to solve this problem, implicit feedback which denotes the limited feedback starts to attract much attention. In this paper, we propose a zero-forcing beamforming (ZFBF) scheme with limited feedback to multiple cells in downlink CoMP system combined with antenna selection at UE. The simulation results indicate that the proposed ZFBF scheme with user scheduling leads to significant sum-rate gain and there is still much to research for improvement.

articleTitle: The Control Method and Experimental Study of HVDC Light Inverter Part
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In this paper, the control method and its application of HVDC Light will be most studied. Firstly, the mathematical model of HVDC Light and the DQ model of VSC are established. Then the structure of control system and the basic control method are introduced for designing VSC controllers. The VSC controller is based on dual-close-loop control strategy.

articleTitle: BP Localization Algorithm Based on Virtual Nodes in Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Accurate localization of nodes is one of the key issues of wireless sensor network (WSN). Considering the proportion of beacons in the network, localization algorithm based on sub-anchors and BP network is proposed in this paper to virtually increase the number of the anchors, and the method of finding appropriate sub-anchors is brought up by the virtual nodes leading to higher localization accuracy. Such algorithm utilizes not only the parallelism of neural networks but also the hops of the nodes, so that it is simple and easy to achieve in the hardware. The simulation shows the effectiveness of using virtual nodes to find sub-anchors, and indicates that sub-anchors and virtual nodes based on BP neural network could greatly improve the accuracy of the unknown nodes and reduce the costs of WSN.

articleTitle: A Kind of Model Construction Method Based on Formal Representation of Decision Problem
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Firstly, the limitation of the existing model construction methods is analyzed. Secondly, formal representation of decision problem is given. Thirdly the construction method of decision model based on formalization representation of decision problem is proposed. Then, the model construction process of the method is discussed in detail in terms of description model and problem model.

articleTitle: Web Usage Mining Based on WAN Users' Behaviors
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Web mining focuses on extracting useful information from large volumes of Web data. Web usage mining (WUM) is one of important application which applies Web mining techniques to discovery usage patterns from Web accessing data. Meanwhile clustering performs a key role in distinguishing different kinds of usage patterns from raw data. Considering usage features of activities, information scope and preference, we propose a two-step K-means clustering algorithm to search user groups in realistic data collected from WAN. In the paper, some useful practical conclusions are also presented to facilitate design of targeting and recommending applications.

articleTitle: Vehicle to Vehicle and Roadside Sensor Communication for Intelligent Navigation
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Hybrid sensor network technology is a key component of future ITS applications. In this paper, we propose a hybrid architecture that combined VANETs and roadside WSNs for intelligent navigation. Different from traditional ITS application, Sensors in WSNs and VANETs are used to perceive and exchange roadside and vehicular information to support the intelligent navigating decision process. We firstly give the system and protocol architecture, and then we discuss the scenarios and use cases of our system in intelligent navigation. After that, we describe the software and hardware implementation of our prototype, conduct a simulation on the discussed scenarios, and present a detailed data communication experimental result to prove the feasibility of our prototype.

articleTitle: Effect of Node Mobility and Network Dimension to the Zigbee Routing Method
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Both the hierarchical tree routing and the table-driven routing algorithm are available in Zigbee specification. However, the routing selection method is not included in the standard. In this article, we analyzed the effect of the node mobility and the change of the network dimension in Zigbee networks. We used OPNET modeler to simulate the Zigbee networks. The simulation results showed the performances of different routing algorithms in the same conditions. We also simulate the performances of different routing methods with the change of the node mobility and network dimension. We analyzed the reasons and made a conclusion. To the networks, of which, the structure is stable or the change of the structure is not much, we figured out the routing selection strategy based on the scale of the networks. We also find the critical boundary for the different routing method. Tree routing may have better performance when the nodes move less than 3 times on average in 100 seconds, the routing discovery method should be used when nodes move more than 4 times.

articleTitle: An Interference Cancellation Scheme for Cognitive Radio Network
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: This paper investigates the interference cancellation for a cognitive radio based CDMA system, and the object is to reduce the interference both to the primary and the cognitive users. We propose a beamforming scheme in which the cognitive users operate in the licensed band without causing any interference to the primary user, while employing the interference cancellation technology at the receive side of the cognitive users to eliminate the passive effect from the primary user to the greatest extent. Simulation results show that the proposed scheme has a significant effect on removing the interference in a cognitive radio based CDMA system.

articleTitle: Efficient Encoder Structures for Non-Binary Cycle Codes
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Low-density parity-check codes with variable node degree two over high order Galois fields, also called non-binary cycle codes, exhibit good error correction performance. In this paper, several efficient encoder structures are proposed for non-binary cycle codes with only one optimized group of non-zero entries in GF(q)(q > 2). The computation complexity and storage requirement are compared for these methods. Considering the underlying sparse graph of cycle code, the encoding complexity is quite low with the proposed modifications. In this way, a proper tradeoff between complexity and performance is achieved for non-binary cycle codes.

articleTitle: Theory and Measurement of Delta RCS for RFID Tag on Various Materials
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Delta radar cross section (RCS) is an important parameter for the performance of passive UHF RFID tag. It determines the bit error rate (BER) at reader side when the signal which backscattered from the tag is polluted by kinds of noises. But the measurement of delta RCS can't be obtained directly and thus, indirect method must be considered. The paper introduces our measurment methodology for tag's delta RCS, including the National Instruments (NI) RF modular and the LabVIEW based signal analysis programe. This paper also has analyzed two main factors which influence delta RCS seriously, and gotten some test results when tags were attached on various material objects for different transmitted power.

articleTitle: Image Quality Assessment Based on DCT and Structural Similarity
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: According to the property that the human visual system has different sensitivities in the frequency domain, a novel image quality assessment algorithm based on Structural Similarity (SSIM) and DCT is proposed. The method takes frequency information as a part of structural information and gets the frequency structural comparison function by weighting the frequency components based on the importance of sensitivities of human eyes. Then the luminance comparison, contrast comparison, structural comparison as defined in SSIM and frequency structural comparison are combined to yield an over all similarity measure. Experimental results illustrate that this algorithm has a good consistency with the subjective assessment of human beings for JPEG2000,Gaussian blur, White Noise images and all images in LIVE database, thus it can be used to describe the visual perception of image more reasonable than SSIM,MS-SSIM and PSNR.

articleTitle: Research on the Reduction of PAPR for OFDM Signals by Companding and Clipping Method
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a union algorithm of Companding and clipping method to reduce Peak-to-average Ratio (PAPR) in Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) system. Firstly, we use companding method to process OFDM signal to reduce PAPR, then the result was further processed by clipping method to reduce PAPR in the union algorithm. The simulation results that if the parameters are selected properly, it would reduce PAPR and not have too much noise by using the union algorithm of companding and clipping method.

articleTitle: Design of Complex FIR Filters with Group Delay Constraints Using Second-Order Cone Programming
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: This paper proposes a new method for the design of complex coefficient finite impulse response (FIR) filters with group delay constraints using second-order cone programming (SOCP). SOCP is a powerful convex optimization method, where linear and convex quadratic inequality constraints can readily be incorporated. It is used in this study for the optimal minimax design of linear-phase and low-delay FIR filters. The proposed approach imposes a non-convex group delay constraint which can be formulated as a second-order cone constraint with reasonable approximations. Simulations are presented to illustrate the performance of the proposed algorithms.

articleTitle: A New Algorithm of Spectrum Allocation for Cognitive Radio Based on Cooperative Game
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Secondary users, which base on the spectrum pricing function given by primary users, can compete the spectrum resource with each other through game theory in cognitive radio system. It can be divided into cooperative game and noncooperative game according to whether the secondary users cooperate or not in the spectrum sharing. In this paper, based on the Nash bargaining in cooperative game, an improved utility function is proposed to maximize the profit product of all the secondary users. The cooperative game algorithm of spectrum allocation in cognitive radio is found and the priority of secondary users is introduced. We prove the existence and uniqueness of NBS (Nash Bargaining Solution) for the new utility in cooperative game. The simulation results show that the new algorithm can reflect the secondary users' priorities of spectrum allocation by setting the parameters properly and make sure the spectrum allocation becomes more efficient and fair.

articleTitle: Video Object Tracking Based on Swarm Optimized Particle Filter
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Abstract - Classical particle filter needs large numbers of samples to properly approximate the posterior density of the state evolution, and moreover, sample impoverishment is an inevitable problem, which is a key issue in the performance of a particle filter. In this paper, particle swarm optimization (PSO) was embedded into generic particle filter framework to achieve more robustness and flexibility. Samples were generated to represent the initial state of the object. Particle swarm optimized the sample set after prediction step. The object was tracked if the samples had reached convergence. Target state estimation was computed according to the globally best location of the entire population. Experiment results demonstrated that particle swarm algorithm can effectively eliminate particle degeneration and enhance robustness. Consequently the efficiency of video object tracking system was effectively improved.

articleTitle: The Access Network and Protocol Design for CoMP Technique in LTE-Advanced System
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: The Coordinated Multi-Point (CoMP) transmission /reception technique has been adopted one of key technologies for LTE-A system in 3GPP LTE project, which can increase the cell average and cell edge user throughput in the both uplink and downlink by joint scheduling and data processing in multiple cells/eNBs. In this paper, the principle of CoMP is introduced, and the CoMP architecture and corresponding protocols stack designs are proposed emphatically. Finally, the system simulations and results are derived to show the CoMP technique can improve the system performance and spectrum utilization greatly.

articleTitle: Deviation-Resistant Traffic-Aware Dynamic Spectrum Access
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Traffic-aware dynamic spectrum access (TDSA) can improve spectrum usage efficiency through demand driven spectrum allocation with the aid of cognitive radios. However, selfish behaviors of participants, such as deviation for more spectrum, can decrease the efficiency of TDSA a lot. In this paper, we prevent APs' deviation in FLEX with trigger punishment in the repeated game. The new TDSA solution can make the participants in FLEX self-enforced to cooperate incentively without deviation. Moreover, this method can also be applied to demand-driven spectrum allocation rules other than FLEX. Simulations show that our scheme can settle the problem in FLEX well, and greatly improve the spectrum efficiency.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Bandwidth Adaptable Third-Order All Digital Phase-Locked Loops
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: A bandwidth adaptable third-order all-digital phase-locked loop (PLL) based on PI control algorithm is proposed in this paper. On the analysis of the mathematical model of analog PLL system, mathematical model for bandwidth adaptable all-digital PLL is firstly established and theoretical analysis is therefore carried out, and then the relationship between the proportional/integral parameters of the PLL and the input signal frequency is derived. And finally under the Matlab/Simulink<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">®</sup> environment, system-level model for the PLL is directly constructed using DSP Builder<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">®</sup>, and system design is completed by using VHDL and is implemented on a FPGA based platform. Both system simulation and experimental results confirm the correctness of the design. The control parameters of this PLL change adaptively with the variation of input signal frequency, and it features with its high frequency-locking speed, wide frequency-tracking range, easy integration and broad versatility.

articleTitle: Identifier Mapping Buffer Management Based on Markov-Repeated-Using-Probability Prediction
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: The Internet can not support mobility and scalability effectively. One of the reasons is the ambiguity of the IP address signification. It has been accepted that the new network architecture needs to separate the locator from its identifier. Identifier is used to present the information source and information sink while the locator is used for routing. It is necessary to use replacement, not encapsulation, for the locator and identifier in the communication because of the security problems arose from the application of encapsulation. In the process of replacement the backup of the locator/identifier mapping information needs storing in the most necessary place, which is a problem of cache management in fact .In this paper the typical cache management algorithms are discussed firstly, and then introduce the dividing method of Access Switch Router (ASR) cache space. On this basis, a Markov Repeated using Probability Prediction algorithm (MRPP) is proposed, in which it focus on the computing method of state transferring matrix and the computing formula of the querying times in the next period. The simulation result shows that the performance of MRPP is better than that of the existing cache management algorithm such as LFU, LRU and LFU-LRU.

articleTitle: A Tree Image Segmentation Method Based on 2-D OTSU in HSI Color Space
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: This paper concerns the problem of tree image segmentation. Image segmentation is the basis of the precision toward-target pesticide application to trees and the real-time and accuracy requirements are very high. In this work, we transformed the image color space from RGB to HIS and normalized the image hue centered on tree hue. Then the color image was segmented by using of an improved 2-D OTSU method. Results show our method has good accuracy and real-time performance and can be used in the precision toward-target pesticide application to trees.

articleTitle: A Nonlinear Memory Power Amplifier Behavior Modeling and Identification Based on Memory Polynomial Model in Soft-Defined Shortwave Transmitter
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: General Volterra series based models have been successfully applied for radio frequency (RF) power amplifier behave-oral modeling, but their high complexity tends to limit their applications to "weakly" nonlinear systems. To model a soft-defined shortwave PA with strong nonlinearities and long memory effects, we propose a memory polynomial model (MP model) which is a simplified Volterra series based model for RF power amplifiers by employing a diagonal pruning algorithm, therefore dramatically reducing the complexity of the behavioral model. The comparison between the simulation results by MP Model and the measured result by the test platform based on DSP and FPGA shows that MP model and adaptive RLS algorithm can describe the nonlinear memory power amplifier behavior characterizes for the soft-defined short-wave amplifier system accurately and effectively. Furthermore, the identification method for soft-defined shortwave transmitter is simple, few parameters, steady algorithm, and practical.

articleTitle: Ant Colony Optimization and Statistical Estimation Approach to Image Edge Detection
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: An edge detection algorithm that combines an ant colony optimization (ACO) and statistical estimation is presented in this paper. The pheromone which can steer the movement of ant is decided by the information of statistical estimation of the pixel's circular neighborhood. The superior performances are shown in the experimental results.

articleTitle: Electricity Demand Forecasting Based on Threepoint Gaussian Quadrature and Its Application in Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: The construction of Smart Grid will comprehensively enhance the intelligent level of every step in the power grid of our country. The data forecasting ability determines the quality of smart grid. As a result of this, this paper constructs the background value of grey GM (1, 1) model by using threepoint Gaussian quadrature formula, improves its accuracy and the data quality. It indicates that reconstruction of the background value is the key factor affecting prediction accuracy and applicability.

articleTitle: A Flexible Architecture for RFID Based Laundry Management Systems
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: This paper novel proposes a flexible RFID based production process management system architecture with the service oriented architecture technology. The system managers can add a new function or a new production process by the visual interface of our architecture. This architecture is used to construct a visualization system prototype which can be used to manage laundry process effectively by using the washable RFID tags. A set of system requirements are developed that cover the design of the nodes of the shops, the storehouses and the laundry factories, the design of the network, the design of the interface, the capabilities for remote data access and management, and the easily expansible services. For easily accessed by internet, this system is developed as a web application. Our system enables reliable laundry management running cheaply and effectively.

articleTitle: Research on the Performance Testing of the New Spatial Information Network Access G/S Mode
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: G/S mode is a brand new spatial data access mode which is especially suitable for spatial information accessing through network. By introducing the software testing theory, a software performance testing on the spatial information network accessing was conducted between the Google Earth based on G/S mode and the Google Maps based on B/S mode. The advantages of G/S mode on the spatial information network accessing can be truly shown by comparing the testing results.

articleTitle: The Application of Information Hiding Technology to Electronic Assignment Anti-Plagiarism
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Plagiarism is a problem for educators all over the world. With the popularity of computers and networks, many teachers give the electronic assignment to their students in the university. But students copy electronic assignment more and more commonly. Information hiding technology is mainly used in the image copyright protection and covert communication currently，here information hiding technology is used in the field of electronic coursework anti- plagiarism creatively. The experimental program can embed the information of originators into the characters of assignment by high robust watermarking algorithm. As the assignment with watermarking is copied by others, the program can detect the similar parts and locate the source of plagiarism accurately and quickly.

articleTitle: A Resource Discovery Algorithm Based on Mobile Ad hoc Network and Its Implementation
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: This paper proposes the mobile resource discovery algorithm called MRDA, which focus on the communication of Mobile Ad-hoc Network (MANET) nodes in a peer-to-peer manner. It utilizes distributed hash tables (DHTs) to efficiently cache the resource information. Meanwhile, we design the simple datagram structure and use dynamic transmission interval of advertising datagram, which can effectively reduce the mobile phone's memory occupancy and decrease the network transmission cost. Finally, we design and implement prototype program of communication between the mobile terminal nodes in MANET environment, which can illustrate the efficiency of MRDA.

articleTitle: Power Allocation Algorithms for OFDM-Based Cognitive Radio Systems
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In this paper, we investigate an optimal power allocation algorithm for OFDM-based cognitive radio. In the model of power allocation, we set the interference constraints for each primary user, and also take subcarrier sidelobes interference (adjacent channel interference (ACI)) into account, when we use the optimal power allocation algorithm, the transmission capacity of secondary users (SU) is maximized while the interference introduced to the primary user (PU) is within a certain range. Because of high complexity of the optimal power allocation algorithm, we also propose two suboptimal power loading algorithms. Simulation results show that the performance of the optimal power allocation algorithm and two suboptimal power loading algorithms is better than conventional water-filling algorithm and uniform power loading algorithm.

articleTitle: A Robust Audio Watermarking Algorithm Based on Statistical Characteristics and DWT+DCT Transforms
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: This paper considers quantization based audio watermarking algorithm based on both Discrete Wavelet Transforms (DWT) and Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT). The embedding information used is a binary image. Different techniques like Arnold Transform and Linear Feedback Shift Register are used for image encryption. Different wavelet filters are considered and the performance is evaluated. Watermark embedding is performed by mean quantization of DCT values of n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> level low frequency components where n ε {3, 4, 5}. Low frequency components contains majority of the signals energy, which helps provide robustness. Synchronization codes are embedded in the low frequency components of the audio signal, and it makes algorithm more robust against desynchronized attacks. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm is inaudible and robust against common signal processing techniques. Our results are better than those obtained using techniques involving only single domain transformations such as [2], [9] and [10].

articleTitle: Combined Multiple Weight Vectors and Receive Antenna Selection
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In order to improve the throughput of the opportunistic beamforming, a technique enhancing opportunistic beamforming is proposed, which combines the multiple vectors and receive antenna selection technique. Using multiple random weighting vectors at the base station and additional receive antennas at the mobile users can be viewed as increasing the effective number of users on the downlink. Significant performance improvement is achieved especially for small number of users. The simplicity and inexpensive deployment of this technique make it a highly desirable enhancement to opportunistic beamforming.

articleTitle: Interoperability of Wireless Networks Based on Layer Modification and LTE with 4G
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Future generation of wireless communication systems are envisioned to offer higher data rates, higher mobility support, transparent and seamless communication. These requirements open potentials for the operators to increase their service portfolio and for the users to experience context-rich and personalized services. Consequently the interoperability between different wireless network platforms emerges as a crucial necessity. Here focus is given to the significance of the network interoperability aspect based on layered approach and its role in the development towards 4G.This paper gives an overview of the major and differentiating features of 4G from other generations. Attention is also paid to the interoperability provided by LTE.

articleTitle: A Stop and Go Blind Equalization Algorithm for QAM Signals
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: The constant modulus algorithm (CMA) has been widely used in the blind equalization of quadrature amplitude modulation (QAM) signals, but it has slow convergence rate and large steady state mean square error and the phase blind nature. In this paper, a modified constant modulus algorithm which incorporates a stop and go technique is proposed. The proposed algorithm can speed up convergence rate and decrease steady state mean square error and correct phase error and frequency offset simultaneously. The simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm in improving convergence behavior and bit error rate (BER) performance.

articleTitle: A Novel Non-Local Means Based Super-Resolution Algorithm with Back-Projection
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: A novel multi-frame super-resolution (SR) algorithm without explicit motion estimation is proposed. This method is intended to promote the precision of SR reconstruction by embedding the back-projection technique into the non-local means (NLM) based fusion and reconstruction process. Results on test movie show that the proposed method is very successful in providing super-resolution on general sequences and is able to remove the bur and edge artifacts effectively.

articleTitle: Implementation of Six-Layer Automatic Elevator Controller Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: This paper introduces the design of FPGA-based elevator controller. Through structural analysis of the system, we use the modular design method. A new FPGA-based elevator controller is designed in order to overcome the defects of traditional single-chip microcomputer-based elevator controller, such as the complexity of peripheral circuit and the instability of the performance. The FPGA chip is used as the core of the controller, and the functions of the controller are described in VHDL language. The editing, debugging and combination of the programs are performed in the integrated software environment-Quarters II 8.1. And at the same time circuit synthesis and simulation is also performed. Finally, the program codes are downloaded to the FPGA chip using specialized cable to implement its functions. This design not only simplifies the design of the circuit, improves the capability of anti-jamming, but lowers the power consumption as well. Thus, the controller has broad application prospects.

articleTitle: Asymptotic Analysis of Decode-and-Forward in Generalized Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: This letter derives a simple and uniform closed-form expression for the asymptotic outage probability of the decode-and-forward relaying transmission in generalized fading channels, including Rayleigh, Ricean, Nakagami-q, and Nakagami-m fading. Various numerical results show that the derived uniform outage probabilities are tight approximation in the high SNR regime. The closed-form expression is helpful to investigate the outage probability of cooperative networks under different fading conditions.

articleTitle: Optimal Power Allocation and Relay Selection in OFDM-Based Cooperative Systems
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In this paper, we consider an OFDM-based cooperative diversity system where a source communicates with a destination with the help of a relay in Amplify-and-Forward relaying or Decode-and-Forward relaying. First, we propose a scheme to selecting the "best" relay to assist the transmission. And then, we present two power allocation schemes to minimize system outage probability, based on statistical channel status information (SCSI, in the form of fading distribution, and path loss information) and instantaneous channel status information (ICSI), respectively From analysis and simulation, we show that with the help of the "best" relay, full diversity order is achieved, and the power allocation schemes have better performance than fixed power allocation in terms of outage behavior.

articleTitle: Research and Improvement of AODV Protocol in Ad Hoc Network
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: The running process of AODV protocol mainly includes two processes, routing find and routing maintenance. AODV protocol uses the method of hop-by-hop routing to transmit packets. Wormhole attack is a special attack method aimed at Ad hoc network. Based on the analysis of AODV protocol and the attack conditions of wormhole attack, the process and algorithm aimed at wormhole attack are researched. At last, a method to improve AODV protocol is put forward.

articleTitle: Comparison of Several Demodulation Algorithms about Hierarchical Modulation in Broadcast Communications
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Using hierarchical modulation technology is very prevalence in existing digital broadcast system, such as satellite TV. A video source can be split into two streams, one stream is called basic stream, the other is called enhance stream. The basic stream contains high-priority information, it can offer basic visual effect, while the enhance stream contains low-priority information, it can make the visual effect much better. So the hierarchical modulation (superposition coding) consists of a basic constellation and a enhance constellation, but the fact is that basic constellation and enhance constellation will be to influence each other. Analysis will be performed to find an optimum hierarchical modulation's demodulation algorithm so as to keep the mutual influence to the minimum and let almost receivers can get good reception in larger coverage.

articleTitle: Smart Sensing Strategy for Wireless Channel Based on Sequence Characterizes Matching Method
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In this paper, we use the software-defined radio platform GNU Radio + USRP to implement a GSM channel smart sensing system by using the wireless channel smart sensing strategy based on sequence characterizes matching method. We adopted multi-step to design the system from physical layer. First, we rough scan the signal intensity of GSM channels, then select the channel that has better signal intensity to precise scan and save the data. Then, according to the sequence characterizes of different type channel, we analysis these data and realize the utilization rate of channels.

articleTitle: The Algorithm of Extracting Energy Curve from X-ray Coherent Scatter Images
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: This paper presents a new method to calculate the Euclidean distance among pixels by taking the gray value of a pixel as the distance weight. The energy distribution curve extracted from coherent scatter images with this method. The signal value of the curve has been intensified and the noise has been reduced effectively.

articleTitle: Cluster Cache Based K-Hop Clustered MANET Routing Protocol
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In cluster cache based k-hop clustered MANET routing protocol (CCBRP), cluster heads cache the information of remote clusters obtained during a route discovery process. When a remote destination is cached by a cluster head, RREP can be send to source directly by cluster head. By this way, the cost of route discovery is decreased. Route caches are maintained by cluster head and re-routing is minimized. Simulating results indicate that with the increase of node moving speed, communicating pairs and decrease of pausing time, CCBRP can rapidly decrease the cost of route discovery of whole network.

articleTitle: Task Assignment for Multi-UAV Using Contract Net Based on Filter Model
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: How to make a faster and more efficient task assignment is a hot issue in the multi-UAVs coordination area, by using the Tactical Digital Information Links (TADILs) to share and exchange combat information in modern aerial warfare. Due to the shortage of traditional contract net, a filter model is proposed according to the negotiation mechanism of contract net protocol theory by R.G. Smith [1], which builds the task assignment model, and defines the restrictions of UAV to extend the framework of contract net. Simulation results show that the extended contract net can significantly reduce the communication traffic and optimize the efficiency of decision-making.

articleTitle: Implementation of Dynamic Spectrum Access Using Enhanced Carrier Sense Multiple Access in Cognitive Radio Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: Nowadays research is being carried out on "Cognitive Radio Networks" as before the advent of the cognitive radio network utilization of frequency band was not so efficient and the major portion of spectrum remain unused mainly above 3 GHz . A cognitive radio network changes its transmitter parameters according to the operating environment and utilizes unused radio spectrum. In this paper we suggested an enhanced version of Carrier Sense Multiple Access to continuously sense the channel and assign bands to users. Using this technique a cognitive radio application has been designed to transmit real time data with minimal interference. The design satisfies the four phases of spectrum management which are classified as spectrum sensing, spectrum decision, spectrum sharing and spectrum mobility. The simulation results regarding the design have been added to the paper.

articleTitle: A New Vehicle Network Routing Technology Based on Power Control
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: The dynamic setting of the node's power value is not involved in the traditional VANET protocol. Thus, the node energy could not be effectively saved, and the channel interference between nodes is likely to be caused. This paper proposes a new vehicle network routing technology based on power control--- PAODV, PAODV mainly uses the power control on link layer, and it is realized through MAC protocol. The transmission power is dynamically adjusted according to the conditions such as the distance to the node of the next hop and channel status. After using PAODV, node's energy consumption is lowered and channel interference between different nodes is reduced. This further ensures the reliability of the routing algorithm. We compare the performance of PAODV and AODV using network simulator NS-2 with the actual node movement model. The simulation results show that this algorithm can significantly reduce nodes' energy consumption.

articleTitle: Frequency Division Multiplexing Wireless Connection
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: In this paper, a newly designed wireless sensing network platform for structural monitoring applications is presented, and the results of a validation test performed in the authors' laboratory are reported. The main features offered by the proposed wireless platform are the capability of real-time and multi-channel data transmission, the high compatibility to different types of sensors, a highly efficient power-supply, and low-cost. Instead of adopting the most commonly used commercial wireless modems, the wireless communication is pursued by implementing an optimized and customized solution based on a recent System on Chip wireless transceiver. The Frequency Division Multiplexing method is exploited to ensure the real-time feature of the multi-channel data transmission. A simple and practical point-to-point topology is pursued. The usage of switching regulators which feature low quiescent current, highly efficient power conversion, an adjustable output voltage, and a high output power make this platform suitable for both low-power and non low-power structural monitoring applications involving different types of sensors. In order to validate the prototyped platform, a laboratory test is performed. The measurements of the acceleration response of a simple 3-storey structure mounted on a shaking table are acquired from both a wired DAQ system and the developed wireless platform. The data comparison enables to validate the efficacy of the real-time, multi-channel wireless transmission.

articleTitle: Cubic Prime Sequences
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
abstract: A new construction of frequency hopping (FH) sequences, designated as cubic prime sequences, is presented in this paper based on the multiplication of extension Galois field GF(P<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>) with P an odd prime. Cubic prime sequences provide more sequences, longer period and more families compared with prime sequences, with ideal Hamming auto-correlation properties and maximum Hamming cross-correlation value four. And after partition, FH sequences in the same group show ideal Hamming cross correlation properties.

articleTitle: GLRT Based Active Spectrum Sensing for Cognitive Radio Systems
publicationTitle: 2010 6th International Conference on Wireless Communications Networking and Mobile Computing (WiCOM)
